1.97.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
savarṇāni graharkṣāṇāṃ diśāṃ ca jagatīpate ..
nityaṃ deyāni vāsāṃsi patākāśca vijānatā .. 1 ..
1.97.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
सवर्णानि ग्रहर्क्षाणां दिशां च जगतीपते ॥
नित्यं देयानि वासांसि पताकाश्च विजानता ॥ 1 ॥
1.97.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Daily, O lord of the earth, one who knows should offer / garments and banners of matching colors to the planets, lunar mansions, and directions.

1.97.s:
bhūṣaṇāni ca deyāni kāñcanāni śubhāni ca ..
ratnacitrāṇi ramyāṇi yathāśaktyā narādhipa .. 2 ..
1.97.d:
भूषणानि च देयानि काञ्चनानि शुभानि च ॥
रत्नचित्राणि रम्याणि यथाशक्त्या नराधिप ॥ 2 ॥
1.97.m: Auspicious ornaments of gold should also be given, / charming and adorned with various gems, according to one's capacity, O ruler of men.

1.97.s:
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate ..
jātīpuṣpāṇi deyāni sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ .. 3 ..
1.97.d:
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां महीपते ॥
जातीपुष्पाणि देयानि सर्वेषामविशेषतः ॥ 3 ॥
1.97.m: To the deities established in fixed shrines, O protector of the earth, / jasmine blossoms should be given, to all without distinction.

1.97.s:
raktapadmāni sūryasya śvetapadmāni cendave ..
bandhūkāni ca bhaumāya budhāyendīvarāṇi ca .. 4 ..
1.97.d:
रक्तपद्मानि सूर्यस्य श्वेतपद्मानि चेन्दवे ॥
बन्धूकानि च भौमाय बुधायेन्दीवराणि च ॥ 4 ॥
1.97.m: Red lotuses to the Sun, and white lotuses to the Moon; / bandhūka blossoms to Mars, and blue waterlilies to Mercury;

1.97.s:
jīvāya yūthikā pītā sitāya ca tathā sitā ..
bāṇapuṣpāṇi saurāya rāhave pāṭalāni ca .. 5 ..
1.97.d:
जीवाय यूथिका पीता सिताय च तथा सिता ॥
बाणपुष्पाणि सौराय राहवे पाटलानि च ॥ 5 ॥
1.97.m: yellow jasmine to Jupiter, and white likewise to Venus; / bāṇa flowers to Saturn, and trumpet flowers to Rāhu;

1.97.s:
tathā damanakaṃ deyaṃ ketave vasudhādhipa ..
kṛttikāsu ca deyāni rājanraktotpalāni ca .. 6 ..
1.97.d:
तथा दमनकं देयं केतवे वसुधाधिप ॥
कृत्तिकासु च देयानि राजन्रक्तोत्पलानि च ॥ 6 ॥
1.97.m: likewise, damanaka should be given to Ketu, O ruler of the earth; / and red waterlilies should be given for the Kṛttikās, O king;

1.97.s:
campakāni ca rohiṇyā ilvilāyāḥ sitotpalam ..
dhattūrakāṇyathārdrāyā ādityasya ca mallikā .. 7 ..
1.97.d:
चम्पकानि च रोहिण्या इल्विलायाः सितोत्पलम् ॥
धत्तूरकाण्यथार्द्राया आदित्यस्य च मल्लिका ॥ 7 ॥
1.97.m: campaka flowers to Rohiṇī, white waterlily to Ilvilā; / dhattūra blossoms to Ārdrā, and Arabian jasmine to [the mansion of] the Sun;

1.97.s:
campakānyeva puṣyasya jātī syātsārpapitryayoḥ ..
bhāgyasya kāntā dātavyā aryamṇaśca suvarcalā ..8 ..
1.97.d:
चम्पकान्येव पुष्यस्य जाती स्यात्सार्पपित्र्ययोः ॥
भाग्यस्य कान्ता दातव्या अर्यम्णश्च सुवर्चला ॥8 ॥
1.97.m: campakas to Puṣya, and jasmine for [the mansions of] the Serpents and the Ancestors; / kāntā should be given to [that of] Bhaga, and suvarcalā to [that of] Aryaman;

1.97.s:
sāvitratvāṣṭrayornityaṃ bandhūkakusumāni ca ..
vāyavyasya ca deyāni sindhuvārāṇi pārthiva .. 9 ..
1.97.d:
सावित्रत्वाष्ट्रयोर्नित्यं बन्धूककुसुमानि च ॥
वायव्यस्य च देयानि सिन्धुवाराणि पार्थिव ॥ 9 ॥
1.97.m: and bandhūka blossoms always to [the mansions of] Savitṛ and Tvaṣṭṛ; / and chaste-tree blossoms should be given to [that of] Vāyu, O king;

1.97.s:
aindrāgnyasya ca deyāni kuraṇḍakusumāni ca ..
raktāśokasya puṣpāṇi tathā maitrasya pārthiva .. 1.97.10 ..
1.97.d:
ऐन्द्राग्न्यस्य च देयानि कुरण्डकुसुमानि च ॥
रक्ताशोकस्य पुष्पाणि तथा मैत्रस्य पार्थिव ॥ 1.97.10 ॥
1.97.m: kuraṇḍa blossoms should be given to [the mansion of] Indra and Agni; / and red aśoka flowers likewise to [that of] Mitra, O king;

1.97.s:
campakāni ca śākrasya tathā deyāni bhūpate ..
mūlasya ca tathā deyaṃ rājankṛṣṇakuheṭakam ..11..
1.97.d:
चम्पकानि च शाक्रस्य तथा देयानि भूपते ॥
मूलस्य च तथा देयं राजन्कृष्णकुहेटकम् ॥11॥
1.97.m: and campaka flowers should likewise be given to [the mansion of] Śakra, O lord of the earth; / and black kuheṭaka should be offered, O king, to Mūla;

1.97.s:
kahlārāṇi tathāpyasya vaiśvadevasya kubjakam..
brāhmasya jātīpuṣpāṇi vaiṣṇavasya ca campakam .. 12 ..
1.97.d:
कह्लाराणि तथाप्यस्य वैश्वदेवस्य कुब्जकम्॥
ब्राह्मस्य जातीपुष्पाणि वैष्णवस्य च चम्पकम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.97.m: white waterlilies to [the mansion of] the Waters, and dwarf rose to [that of] the All-gods; / jasmine blossoms to [that of] Brahmā, and campaka to [that of] Viṣṇu;

1.97.s:
pāṭalā vāsavasyāpi vāruṇasyotpalāni tu ..
arkapuṣpāṇyathāpyasya tathā deyāni pārthiva .. 13 ..
1.97.d:
पाटला वासवस्यापि वारुणस्योत्पलानि तु ॥
अर्कपुष्पाण्यथाप्यस्य तथा देयानि पार्थिव ॥ 13 ॥
1.97.m: trumpet flowers to [the mansion of] the Vasus, and blue lotuses to [that of] Varuṇa; / and swallow-wort blossoms should likewise be given to [the mansion of] the Sun, O king;

1.97.s:
āhirbudhnyasya deyāni dhattūrakusumāni ca ..
karavīrakapuṣpāṇi tathā pauṣṇasya pārthiva .. 14 ..
1.97.d:
आहिर्बुध्न्यस्य देयानि धत्तूरकुसुमानि च ॥
करवीरकपुष्पाणि तथा पौष्णस्य पार्थिव ॥ 14 ॥
1.97.m: dhattūra flowers should be given to [the mansion of] Ahirbudhnya; / and oleander blossoms likewise to [that of] Pūṣan, O king;

1.97.s:
cūtapuṣpāṇi deyāni āśvinasya narādhipa ..
nīlotpalāni yāmyasya tathā deyāni bhūpate .. 15 ..
1.97.d:
चूतपुष्पाणि देयानि आश्विनस्य नराधिप ॥
नीलोत्पलानि याम्यस्य तथा देयानि भूपते ॥ 15 ॥
1.97.m: mango blossoms should be given to [the mansion of] the Aśvins, O ruler of men; / blue waterlilies should be offered to [that of] Yama, O lord of the earth;

1.97.s:
samānaveśanakṣatrakathitāni tathā diśām ..
uttarāyāśca deyāni nāgapuṣpāṇi pārthiva .. 16 ..
1.97.d:
समानवेशनक्षत्रकथितानि तथा दिशाम् ॥
उत्तरायाश्च देयानि नागपुष्पाणि पार्थिव ॥ 16 ॥
1.97.m: and for the directions, those prescribed for their shared lunar mansions [should be given]; / and nāgapuṣpa flowers should be given to the northern [direction], O king.

1.97.s:
sāgarāṇāṃ ca deyāni kamalāni mahīpate ..
uktālābhe pradeyāni savarṇāni narādhipa ..
svakālajāni puṣpāṇi sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ .. 17 ..
1.97.d:
सागराणां च देयानि कमलानि महीपते ॥
उक्तालाभे प्रदेयानि सवर्णानि नराधिप ॥
स्वकालजानि पुष्पाणि सर्वेषामविशेषतः ॥ 17 ॥
1.97.m: And lotuses should be given to the oceans, O lord of the earth; / in the absence of what has been stated, flowers of matching color, / grown in their proper season, should be given to all without distinction, O ruler of men.

1.97.s:
yadyadrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti ..18..
1.97.d:
यद्यद्रहस्याभिहितं मयात्र ऋक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान ॥
तद्देवतायाश्च तथैव देयं दिशस्तथा नात्र विचारणास्ति ॥18॥
1.97.m: Whatever has been declared by me here for a planet or a lunar mansion, O foremost of kings, / precisely that should likewise be given to its presiding deity, and to the direction; herein there is no doubt.

1.98.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate ..
gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dhūpaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 1 ..
1.98.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां महीपते ॥
गुग्गुलुं घृतसंयुक्तं धूपं दद्याद्विचक्षणः ॥ 1 ॥
1.98.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To the deities established in fixed shrines, O protector of the earth, / a wise man should offer guggulu mixed with clarified butter as incense.

1.98.s:
dhūpaṃ tvagururarkāya nameruṃ ca tathendave ..
bhaumāya gugguluṃ dadyātsarjaṃ dayādbudhāya ca .. 2 ..
1.98.d:
धूपं त्वगुरुरर्काय नमेरुं च तथेन्दवे ॥
भौमाय गुग्गुलुं दद्यात्सर्जं दयाद्बुधाय च ॥ 2 ॥
1.98.m: Agallochum as incense to the Sun, and nameru incense likewise to the Moon; / one should give guggulu to Mars, and one should offer resin to Mercury;

1.98.s:
śilājatu tu jīvāya dātavyaṃ pārthivottama ..
śrīvāsakaṃ tu śukrāya nakhaṃ saurāya pārthiva ..
madaśca rāhave deyaṃ ketave ca vasā tathā .. 3 ..
1.98.d:
शिलाजतु तु जीवाय दातव्यं पार्थिवोत्तम ॥
श्रीवासकं तु शुक्राय नखं सौराय पार्थिव ॥
मदश्च राहवे देयं केतवे च वसा तथा ॥ 3 ॥
1.98.m: bitumen should be given to Jupiter, O best of kings; / pine resin to Venus, and sweet-scented nail-shaped incense to Saturn, O king; / musk should be given to Rāhu, and fat likewise to Ketu;

1.98.s:
kṛttikānāṃ ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ rohiṇīnāṃ ca candanam ..
ilvalānāṃ ca karpūramārdrāyāṃ ca nakhaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
1.98.d:
कृत्तिकानां घृतं देयं रोहिणीनां च चन्दनम् ॥
इल्वलानां च कर्पूरमार्द्रायां च नखं तथा ॥ 4 ॥
1.98.m: clarified butter should be given to the Kṛttikās, and sandalwood to the Rohiṇīs; / camphor to the Ilvalās, and sweet-scented nail-shaped incense to Ārdrā;

1.98.s:
punarvasoścāpyaguruṃ puṣyasya ca tathākṣatam ..
śrīvāsakaṃ ca sārpasya paitrasya ca tathā ghṛtam ..5 ..
1.98.d:
पुनर्वसोश्चाप्यगुरुं पुष्यस्य च तथाक्षतम् ॥
श्रीवासकं च सार्पस्य पैत्रस्य च तथा घृतम् ॥5 ॥
1.98.m: and agallochum to Punarvasu, and unbroken grains likewise to Puṣya; / pine resin to [the mansion of] the Serpents, and clarified butter likewise to [that of] the Ancestors;

1.98.s:
priyaṅguṃ madhunā yuktaṃ bhāgyasya saghṛtaṃ bhavet ..
ghṛtena madhunā yuktamāryamṇasya śatāvarīm .. 6 ..
1.98.d:
प्रियङ्गुं मधुना युक्तं भाग्यस्य सघृतं भवेत् ॥
घृतेन मधुना युक्तमार्यम्णस्य शतावरीम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.98.m: priyaṅgu combined with honey and clarified butter should belong to [the mansion of] Bhaga; / asparagus combined with clarified butter and honey to [that of] Aryaman;

1.98.s:
kunduruṃ caiva hastāya tvāṣṭrāya ca palaṃ bhavet ..
vāyavyāya ca karpūramaindrāgnyāya misirbhavet .. 7 ..
1.98.d:
कुन्दुरुं चैव हस्ताय त्वाष्ट्राय च पलं भवेत् ॥
वायव्याय च कर्पूरमैन्द्राग्न्याय मिसिर्भवेत् ॥ 7 ॥
1.98.m: frankincense to Hasta, and bdellium gum should belong to [the mansion of] Tvaṣṭṛ; / camphor to [that of] Vāyu, and aniseed should belong to [that of] Indra and Agni;

1.98.s:
maitrāya kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ śākrāya mṛgajaṃ bhavet ..
śāṭīmūlaṃ ca mūlāya āpyāya naladaṃ tathā .. 8 ..
1.98.d:
मैत्राय कुङ्कुमं देयं शाक्राय मृगजं भवेत् ॥
शाटीमूलं च मूलाय आप्याय नलदं तथा ॥ 8 ॥
1.98.m: saffron should be given to [the mansion of] Mitra, and musk should belong to [that of] Śakra; / zedoary root to Mūla, and spikenard likewise to [that of] the Waters;

1.98.s:
gugguluṃ vaiśvadevāya brāhmāya ghṛtacandane ..
vaiṣṇavāyāguruṃ dadyādvāsavāya tathā palam .. 9 ..
1.98.d:
गुग्गुलुं वैश्वदेवाय ब्राह्माय घृतचन्दने ॥
वैष्णवायागुरुं दद्याद्वासवाय तथा पलम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.98.m: guggulu to [the mansion of] the All-gods, and clarified butter and sandalwood to [that of] Brahmā; / one should give agallochum to [that of] Viṣṇu, and bdellium gum likewise to [that of] the Vasus;

1.98.s:
vāruṇāya tathośīramājāya ca palaṃ bhavet ..
ahirbudhnyāya dātavyaṃ devadāruṃ narādhipa .. 1.98.10 ..
1.98.d:
वारुणाय तथोशीरमाजाय च पलं भवेत् ॥
अहिर्बुध्न्याय दातव्यं देवदारुं नराधिप ॥ 1.98.10 ॥
1.98.m: vetiver likewise to [the mansion of] Varuṇa, and bdellium gum should belong to [that of] Aja; / deodar should be given to Ahirbudhnya, O ruler of men.

1.98.s:
kaṅkolakāni pauṣṇāya āśvināya ca candanam ..
yamyāya guggulurdeyaḥ satataṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 11 ..
1.98.d:
कङ्कोलकानि पौष्णाय आश्विनाय च चन्दनम् ॥
यम्याय गुग्गुलुर्देयः सततं भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 11 ॥
1.98.m: Cubebs should be given to Pauṣṇa, and sandalwood to Āśvina; / bdellium is constantly to be given to Yāmya by one desiring prosperity.

1.98.s:
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva candanaṃ mṛgajaṃ tathā ..
turuṣkamaguruṃ kāntāṃ gugguluṃ ca kramāddiśām .. 12 ..
1.98.d:
कर्पूरं कुङ्कुमं चैव चन्दनं मृगजं तथा ॥
तुरुष्कमगुरुं कान्तां गुग्गुलुं च क्रमाद्दिशाम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.98.m: Camphor, saffron, sandalwood, musk, / olibanum, agallochum, priyaṅgu, and bdellium, respectively, for the directions,

1.98.s:
prācyādīnāṃ mahīnātha sāgarāṇāṃ ca candanam ..
sarvābhāve ca dātavyāḥ sarveṣāmeva guggulum .. 13..
1.98.d:
प्राच्यादीनां महीनाथ सागराणां च चन्दनम् ॥
सर्वाभावे च दातव्याः सर्वेषामेव गुग्गुलुम् ॥ 13॥
1.98.m: beginning with the east, O lord of the earth; and sandalwood for the oceans. / In the absence of all [these], bdellium alone must be given to all.

1.98.s:
vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ ..
āghrāṇaḥ sarvadevānāṃ guggulupravaraḥ śubhaḥ ..14..
1.98.d:
वनस्पतिरसो दिव्यो गन्धाढ्यो गन्ध उत्तमः ॥
आघ्राणः सर्वदेवानां गुग्गुलुप्रवरः शुभः ॥14॥
1.98.m: A divine sap of trees, rich in scent, an excellent fragrance, / an aroma for all the gods, auspicious bdellium is supreme.

1.98.s:
dīpaścājyena dātavyaḥ sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ ..
tailena vā mahīnātha vasāḍhyena vivarjayet ..15..
1.98.d:
दीपश्चाज्येन दातव्यः सर्वेषामविशेषतः ॥
तैलेन वा महीनाथ वसाढ्येन विवर्जयेत् ॥15॥
1.98.m: A lamp should be given with ghee to all without distinction, / or with oil, O lord of the earth; one must avoid one rich in fat.

1.98.s:
yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna..
taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśāṃ tathā nātra vicāramasti..16..
1.98.d:
यद्यद्ग्रहस्याभिहितं मयात्र ऋक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान॥
तद्देवतायाश्च तथैव देयं दिशां तथा नात्र विचारमस्ति॥16॥
1.98.m: Whatever has been stated by me here for a planet or a lunar mansion, O foremost of kings, / should likewise be given to its deity, and similarly for the directions; there is no doubt here.

1.98.s: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde graharkṣadhūpadīpo nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 98 .. ..
1.98.d: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे ग्रहर्क्षधूपदीपो नामाष्टनवतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 98 ॥ ॥
1.98.m: Thus ends the ninety-eighth chapter, named 'Incense and Lamps for the Planets and Asterisms', in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the First Book of the illustrious Viṣṇudharmottara.

1.99.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ narādhipa ..
dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca pratyekaṃ vinivedayet .. 1 ..
1.99.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां नराधिप ॥
दध्योदनं पायसं च प्रत्येकं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
1.99.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To the deities established in the fixed position, O lord of men, / one should offer curd-rice and milk-rice individually.

1.99.s:
guḍaudanaṃ guḍāpūpāḥ phalāni guḍapāyasam ..
nivedanaṃ tu sūryāya dhānyalāje madhūtkaṭe .. 2 ..
1.99.d:
गुडौदनं गुडापूपाः फलानि गुडपायसम् ॥
निवेदनं तु सूर्याय धान्यलाजे मधूत्कटे ॥ 2 ॥
1.99.m: Jaggery-rice, jaggery-cakes, fruits, and jaggery-milk-rice, / and grain-parched-paddy abundant in honey, is the offering to the Sun.

1.99.s:
sarpirdadhyodanaṃ caiva phalāni vividhāni ca ..
modakāni ca mukhyāni pāyasaṃ śaśinastathā .. 3 ..
1.99.d:
सर्पिर्दध्योदनं चैव फलानि विविधानि च ॥
मोदकानि च मुख्यानि पायसं शशिनस्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
1.99.m: Curd-rice with clarified butter, various kinds of fruits, / choice modakas, and milk-rice likewise for the Moon.

1.99.s:
guḍaudanaṃ guḍāpūpā yāvakaṃ guḍapāyasam ..
kṛsaraṃ ca tathā deyaṃ bhūmiputrāya pārthiva .. 4 ..
1.99.d:
गुडौदनं गुडापूपा यावकं गुडपायसम् ॥
कृसरं च तथा देयं भूमिपुत्राय पार्थिव ॥ 4 ॥
1.99.m: Jaggery-rice, jaggery-cakes, barley porridge, jaggery-milk-rice, / and kṛsara should likewise be given to the Son of the Earth, O king.

1.99.s:
kṣīraudanaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ kṣīravṛkṣaphalāni ca ..
kṣīriṇyaśca tathoṣadhyo somaputrāya dāpayet .. 5 ..
1.99.d:
क्षीरौदनं ससर्पिष्कं क्षीरवृक्षफलानि च ॥
क्षीरिण्यश्च तथोषध्यो सोमपुत्राय दापयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
1.99.m: Rice cooked in milk with clarified butter, fruits of milk-exuding trees, / and milk-yielding herbs one should cause to be given to the Son of the Moon.

1.99.s:
śimbidhānyavikārāṇi bilvānyāmalakāni ca ..
ghṛtaudanaṃ ca jīvāya dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 6 ..
1.99.d:
शिम्बिधान्यविकाराणि बिल्वान्यामलकानि च ॥
घृतौदनं च जीवाय दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 6 ॥
1.99.m: Preparations of podded grains, bilva fruits and āmalaka fruits, / and rice cooked in clarified butter should be given to Jīva by one desiring prosperity.

1.99.s:
dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca madhunā sarpiṣā yutam.. .
utkārikaṃ modakāṃśca bhārgavāya nivedayet ... 7 ..
1.99.d:
दध्योदनं पायसं च मधुना सर्पिषा युतम्॥ ।
उत्कारिकं मोदकांश्च भार्गवाय निवेदयेत् ॥। 7 ॥
1.99.m: Curd-rice and milk-rice combined with honey and clarified butter, / sweet pancakes, and modakas one should offer to Bhārgava.

1.99.s:
māṣaudanaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ kṛsaraṃ dadhi yāvakam..
nivedayettu saurāya kulatthaṃ caṇakaiḥ saha..8..
1.99.d:
माषौदनं ससर्पिष्कं कृसरं दधि यावकम्॥
निवेदयेत्तु सौराय कुलत्थं चणकैः सह॥8॥
1.99.m: Urad-bean rice with clarified butter, kṛsara, curds, barley porridge, / and horse-gram with chickpeas one should offer to Saura.

1.99.s:
plakṣaṃ dadhitthaṃ ca tathā palalaṃ caiva rāhave..
māṣaudanaṃ tathā deyaṃ yavāpūpāṃstathaiva ca..9..
1.99.d:
प्लक्षं दधित्थं च तथा पललं चैव राहवे॥
माषौदनं तथा देयं यवापूपांस्तथैव च॥9॥
1.99.m: Plakṣa, kapittha fruit, and also sesamum paste to Rāhu; / rice cooked with urad beans is likewise to be given, and barley-cakes as well.

1.99.s:
tallopikāstathā matsyāḥ ketave kṛsaraṃ tathā ..
vasāsarpīṃṣi ca tathā deyāni manujeśvara .. 1.99.10 ..
1.99.d:
तल्लोपिकास्तथा मत्स्याः केतवे कृसरं तथा ॥
वसासर्पींषि च तथा देयानि मनुजेश्वर ॥ 1.99.10 ॥
1.99.m: Sweet rolled pastries, fish, and also kṛsara to Ketu, / and fat and clarified butter are likewise to be given, O lord of men.

1.99.s:
madhulāje kṛttikānāṃ kulmāṣaṃ dadhisarpiṣī ..
rohiṇīnāṃ ca bījāni dadhipiṣṭavṛṣāṇi ca .. 11 ..
1.99.d:
मधुलाजे कृत्तिकानां कुल्माषं दधिसर्पिषी ॥
रोहिणीनां च बीजानि दधिपिष्टवृषाणि च ॥ 11 ॥
1.99.m: Honeyed parched paddy for the Kṛttikās; sour barley mash, curds, and clarified butter, / and seeds, curds, and bulls made of flour for the Rohiṇīs.

1.99.s:
dadhyodakaṃ celvalānāṃ mṛgamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca ..
rudhiraṃ kṛsaraṃ cobhau raudrasya vinivedayet .. 12 ..
1.99.d:
दध्योदकं चेल्वलानां मृगमांसं तथैव च ॥
रुधिरं कृसरं चोभौ रौद्रस्य विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
1.99.m: Curd-water for the Ilvalas, and deer meat likewise; / both blood and kṛsara one should offer to Raudra.

1.99.s:
punarvasoḥ pradātavyaṃ palalaṃ savilāyanam ..
pāyasaṃ ca sasarpiṣkaṃ tiṣyāya vinivedayet .. 13 ..
1.99.d:
पुनर्वसोः प्रदातव्यं पललं सविलायनम् ॥
पायसं च ससर्पिष्कं तिष्याय विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 13 ॥
1.99.m: Sesamum paste with melting oil is to be given to Punarvasu, / and milk-rice with clarified butter one should offer to Tiṣya.

1.99.s:
piṣṭasarpāṇi sārpasya kṣaudraṃ dadhiyutaṃ tathā ..
tilaudanaṃ sapalalaṃ paitryasya vinivedayet .. 14 ..
1.99.d:
पिष्टसर्पाणि सार्पस्य क्षौद्रं दधियुतं तथा ॥
तिलौदनं सपललं पैत्र्यस्य विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.99.m: Flour serpents for Sārpa, and honey accompanied by curds; / sesamum-rice with sesamum paste one should offer to Paitrya.

1.99.s:
ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ ca bhāgyasya madhusarpīṃṣi cāpyatha ..
āryamṇāya tilāpūpānṣaṣṭikānnaṃ tathaiva ca .. .. 15 ..
1.99.d:
षष्टिकान्नं च भाग्यस्य मधुसर्पींषि चाप्यथ ॥
आर्यम्णाय तिलापूपान्षष्टिकान्नं तथैव च ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
1.99.m: Rice of sixty-day grain for Bhāgya, and honey and clarified butter as well; / sesamum-cakes and rice of sixty-day grain likewise for Āryamṇa.

1.99.s:
priyaṃgutaṇḍulaiḥ siddhaṃ sāvitrāya ca pāyasam ..
tvāṣṭrasya caiva pīyūṣaṃ dvijā citrāṇḍajāstathā .. 16 ..
1.99.d:
प्रियंगुतण्डुलैः सिद्धं सावित्राय च पायसम् ॥
त्वाष्ट्रस्य चैव पीयूषं द्विजा चित्राण्डजास्तथा ॥ 16 ॥
1.99.m: Milk-rice prepared with Italian millet grains for Sāvitra; / and biestings for Tvāṣṭra, twice-born [birds], and also multi-coloured egg-born creatures.

1.99.s:
vāyavyasya ca phalguni mūlakāni śubhāni ca ..
kulatthāni viśākhāsu yavāpūpāstathaiva ca .. 17 ..
1.99.d:
वायव्यस्य च फल्गुनि मूलकानि शुभानि च ॥
कुलत्थानि विशाखासु यवापूपास्तथैव च ॥ 17 ॥
1.99.m: And auspicious radishes for the Phalgunī of Vāyu; / horse-gram and barley-cakes likewise for the Viśākhās.

1.99.s:
kulatthabhaktaṃ mitrāya dadhikṣaudrānvitaṃ tathā ..
ghṛtaudanaṃ ca śākrāya phalāni vividhāni ca .. 18 ..
1.99.d:
कुलत्थभक्तं मित्राय दधिक्षौद्रान्वितं तथा ॥
घृतौदनं च शाक्राय फलानि विविधानि च ॥ 18 ॥
1.99.m: Boiled horse-gram for Mitra, accompanied by curds and honey; / and rice cooked in clarified butter for Śākra, as well as various fruits.

1.99.s:
mūlāni ca vicitrāṇi tathā mūlaphalāni ca ..
āpyasya saktavo deyā madhumiśrodakaiḥ saha .. 19 ..
1.99.d:
मूलानि च विचित्राणि तथा मूलफलानि च ॥
आप्यस्य सक्तवो देया मधुमिश्रोदकैः सह ॥ 19 ॥
1.99.m: Various roots and edible root-fruits likewise; / barley meal with water mixed with honey is to be given to Āpya.

1.99.s:
saktavo vaiśvadevāya madhulāje tathaiva ca ..
brāhmāya pāyasaṃ deyaṃ saguḍaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 1.99.20 ..
1.99.d:
सक्तवो वैश्वदेवाय मधुलाजे तथैव च ॥
ब्राह्माय पायसं देयं सगुडं भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 1.99.20 ॥
1.99.m: Barley meal for Vaiśvadeva, and honeyed parched paddy likewise; / milk-rice with jaggery should be given to Brāhma by one desiring prosperity.

1.99.s:
dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca vaiṣṇavāya nivedayet ..
ghṛtodakaṃ ca śākāni vāsavāya nivedayet ..21..
1.99.d:
दध्योदनं पायसं च वैष्णवाय निवेदयेत् ॥
घृतोदकं च शाकानि वासवाय निवेदयेत् ॥21॥
1.99.m: Curd-rice and milk-rice one should offer to Vaiṣṇava; / clarified butter-water and leafy vegetables one should offer to Vāsava.

1.99.s:
paiṣṭaṃ biḍālaṃ śākāṃśca vāruṇāya tathā dadhi ..
ādāya māṃsamājaṃ tu vyāghraṃ piṣṭakṛtaṃ dadhi ..22..
1.99.d:
पैष्टं बिडालं शाकांश्च वारुणाय तथा दधि ॥
आदाय मांसमाजं तु व्याघ्रं पिष्टकृतं दधि ॥22॥
1.99.m: A flour cat, leafy vegetables, and curds for Vāruṇa; / having taken goat meat, a flour-made tiger, and curds,

1.99.s:
āhirbudhnyāya māṃsāni tathaiva ca rasaudanam ..
pauṣṇāya saktavo māṣā māṣayuktāśca saktavaḥ ..23..
1.99.d:
आहिर्बुध्न्याय मांसानि तथैव च रसौदनम् ॥
पौष्णाय सक्तवो माषा माषयुक्ताश्च सक्तवः ॥23॥
1.99.m: meats, and likewise broth-rice, for Āhirbudhnya; / for Pauṣṇa, barley meal, urad beans, and barley meal mixed with urad beans.

1.99.s:
aśvaṃ piṣṭakṛtaṃ māṣānyāvakaṃ ca tathā dadhi ..
āśvinasyātha yāmyasya taṇḍulāni tilāni ca..24..
1.99.d:
अश्वं पिष्टकृतं माषान्यावकं च तथा दधि ॥
आश्विनस्याथ याम्यस्य तण्डुलानि तिलानि च॥24॥
1.99.m: A flour-made horse, urad beans, barley porridge, and curds / for Āśvina; and then husked grains and sesamum seeds for Yāmya.

1.99.s:
rājanpaiṣṭāśca paśavo māṃsaṃ pakvāmakaṃ tathā..
pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ pūrvasyāṃ vinivedayet..25..
1.99.d:
राजन्पैष्टाश्च पशवो मांसं पक्वामकं तथा॥
पायसं सघृतं क्षौद्रं पूर्वस्यां विनिवेदयेत्॥25॥
1.99.m: Flour animals, O king, and cooked as well as raw meat, / milk-rice with clarified butter, and honey one should offer in the east.

1.99.s:
āgneyyāṃ diśi rājendra kṛsaraṃ kṣīramiśritam..
dakṣiṇasyāṃ ca dātavyaṃ kṛsaraṃ tailamiśritam.ā26.
nairṛtyāṃ ca pradātavyaṃ kṛsaraṃ matsyasaṃyutam.
kulmāṣāṃścaiva matsyāṃśca paścimasyāṃ nivedayet ..27..
1.99.d:
आग्नेय्यां दिशि राजेन्द्र कृसरं क्षीरमिश्रितम्॥
दक्षिणस्यां च दातव्यं कृसरं तैलमिश्रितम्।आ26.
नैरृत्यां च प्रदातव्यं कृसरं मत्स्यसंयुतम्।
कुल्माषांश्चैव मत्स्यांश्च पश्चिमस्यां निवेदयेत् ॥27॥
1.99.m: In the south-eastern direction, O foremost of kings, kṛsara mixed with milk; / and in the southern, kṛsara mixed with oil is to be given; / in the south-western, kṛsara combined with fish is to be given; / and sour barley mash and fish one should offer in the western.

1.99.s:
vāyavyāyāśca matsyāni tathā kṣīrodanāni ca ..
aiśānyāyāḥ pradātavyau ghṛtakṣīrodanāvubhau..28 ..
1.99.d:
वायव्यायाश्च मत्स्यानि तथा क्षीरोदनानि च ॥
ऐशान्यायाः प्रदातव्यौ घृतक्षीरोदनावुभौ॥28 ॥
1.99.m: Fish and milk-rice for the north-western; / for the north-eastern, both ghee-rice and milk-rice are to be given.

1.99.s: modakollopikāmiśrāḥ sāgarāṇāṃ balirbhavet ..29..
1.99.d: मोदकोल्लोपिकामिश्राः सागराणां बलिर्भवेत् ॥29॥
1.99.m: The oblation for the oceans should be mixed with modakas and rolled pastries.

1.99.s:
yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
taddevatāyāśca tadeva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti .. 1.99.30 ..
1.99.d:
यद्यद्ग्रहस्याभिहितं मयात्र ऋक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान ॥
तद्देवतायाश्च तदेव देयं दिशस्तथा नात्र विचारणास्ति ॥ 1.99.30 ॥
1.99.m: Whatever has been stated by me here for a planet or a lunar mansion, O foremost of kings, / that very thing should be given to its deity, and similarly for the direction; there is no question about this.

1.100.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
pānāya dāpayetkṣīraṃ prītaye vāntarātmanaḥ..
gandhodakaṃ tathārkāya payaḥ somāya kīrtitam .. 1 ..
1.100.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
पानाय दापयेत्क्षीरं प्रीतये वान्तरात्मनः॥
गन्धोदकं तथार्काय पयः सोमाय कीर्तितम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.100.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To the deities established in the fixed position, one should cause milk / to be given individually for drinking, or for the pleasure of the Inner Self. / Scented water is mentioned for Arka, and milk for Soma;

1.100.s:
bhūmiputrāya kharjūraṃ mārdvīkaṃ śaśijāya ca..
jīvāya ca tathā takraṃ śukrāyekṣurasaṃ tathā .. 2 ..
1.100.d:
भूमिपुत्राय खर्जूरं मार्द्वीकं शशिजाय च॥
जीवाय च तथा तक्रं शुक्रायेक्षुरसं तथा ॥ 2 ॥
1.100.m: date juice for the Son of the Earth, wine made from grapes for the Son of the Moon, / buttermilk for Jīva, and sugar-cane juice for Śukra;

1.100.s:
māṃsapānaṃ tu saurāya rāhormīnarasaṃ tathā ..
chāgaṃ payaḥ pradātavyaṃ ketave manujeśvara .. 3 ..
1.100.d:
मांसपानं तु सौराय राहोर्मीनरसं तथा ॥
छागं पयः प्रदातव्यं केतवे मनुजेश्वर ॥ 3 ॥
1.100.m: a meat drink for Saura, fish broth for Rāhu, / and goat milk is to be given to Ketu, O lord of men.

1.100.s:
gandhodakaṃ ca kṛttikānāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ suvīrakam ..
ilvalānāṃ payaḥ proktaṃ raudreḥ khārjūramāsavam .. 4
1.100.d:
गन्धोदकं च कृत्तिकानां रोहिणीनां सुवीरकम् ॥
इल्वलानां पयः प्रोक्तं रौद्रेः खार्जूरमासवम् ॥ 4
1.100.m: Scented water for the Kṛttikās, fermented barley-water for the Rohiṇīs, / milk is declared for the Ilvalas, and date wine for Raudra.

1.100.s:
ādityāya tathā gauḍaṃ kṣīraṃ tiṣyāya dāpayet..
kṣīrameva ca sārpāya tathā pitryāya yādava ..5..
1.100.d:
आदित्याय तथा गौडं क्षीरं तिष्याय दापयेत्॥
क्षीरमेव च सार्पाय तथा पित्र्याय यादव ॥5॥
1.100.m: Jaggery-drink for Āditya, and one should cause milk to be given to Tiṣya; / milk alone for Sārpa, and likewise for Pitrya, O descendant of Yadu;

1.100.s:
gandhodakaṃ ca bhāgyāya tathāryamṇāya kīrtitam..
sāvitrāya tathāyastu tvāṣṭrāya ca tathā payaḥ ..6..
1.100.d:
गन्धोदकं च भाग्याय तथार्यम्णाय कीर्तितम्॥
सावित्राय तथायस्तु त्वाष्ट्राय च तथा पयः ॥6॥
1.100.m: and scented water is mentioned for Bhāgya, as well as for Āryamṇa; / and iron-water for Sāvitra, and milk for Tvāṣṭra.

1.100.s:
vāyavyāya ca mārdvīkamaindrāgnyāya ca kāñjikam ..
mitrāya takraṃ deyaṃ ca śākrāya dadhi dāpayet .. 7 ..
1.100.d:
वायव्याय च मार्द्वीकमैन्द्राग्न्याय च काञ्जिकम् ॥
मित्राय तक्रं देयं च शाक्राय दधि दापयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
1.100.m: And grape wine [should be offered] to the wind-deity, and sour rice-gruel to Indra and Agni together; / buttermilk should be given to Mitra, and curd to Śakra.

1.100.s:
nārikelāmbu mūlāya tathāpyāya madhūdakam ..
khārjūraṃ vaiśvadevāya brāhmāya salilaṃ hitam .. 8 ..
1.100.d:
नारिकेलाम्बु मूलाय तथाप्याय मधूदकम् ॥
खार्जूरं वैश्वदेवाय ब्राह्माय सलिलं हितम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.100.m: Coconut water [is fit] for Mūla, and honey-water likewise for the water-god; / date-wine for the Viśvedevas, and water is beneficial for Brahmā.

1.100.s:
āmraiḥ pānaṃ vaiṣṇavāya jambubhirvāsavāya ca ..
vāruṇāya madhūkaiśca rasamājasya pārthiva .. 9 ..
1.100.d:
आम्रैः पानं वैष्णवाय जम्बुभिर्वासवाय च ॥
वारुणाय मधूकैश्च रसमाजस्य पार्थिव ॥ 9 ॥
1.100.m: A drink of mangoes for Viṣṇu, and with rose-apples for Indra; / and [a drink] with madhūka flowers for Varuṇa, and goat-milk whey, O king,

1.100.s:
āhirbudhnyasya ca tathā rasameva bhavennṛpa ..
pauṣṇāya ca bhavecchāgaṃ cāśvināya ca māhiṣam ..
yāmyāya ca tathā deyaṃ svacchaṃ māṃsarasaṃ tathā .. 1.100.10 ..
1.100.d:
आहिर्बुध्न्यस्य च तथा रसमेव भवेन्नृप ॥
पौष्णाय च भवेच्छागं चाश्विनाय च माहिषम् ॥
याम्याय च तथा देयं स्वच्छं मांसरसं तथा ॥ 1.100.10 ॥
1.100.m: and likewise broth of a goat for Ahirbudhnya, O king; / and goat's [milk] for Pūṣan, and buffalo's [milk] for the Aśvins; / and likewise clear meat-broth should be offered to Yama.

1.100.s:
samānadevanakṣatraṃ kathitaṃ ca tathā diśām ..
uttarāyai pradātavyaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ narādhipa .. 11 ..
1.100.d:
समानदेवनक्षत्रं कथितं च तथा दिशाम् ॥
उत्तरायै प्रदातव्यं तथा क्षीरं नराधिप ॥ 11 ॥
1.100.m: The constellations have been declared having deities equal to those of the directions; / likewise milk should be offered to the northern [direction], O ruler of men,
and to all the oceans, by one who constantly desires prosperity.

1.100.s:
yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti .. 13 ..
1.100.d:
यद्यद्ग्रहस्याभिहितं मयात्र ऋक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान ॥
तद्देवतायाश्च तथैव देयं दिशस्तथा नात्र विचारणास्ति ॥ 13 ॥
1.100.m: Whatever has been stated by me here for a planet or for a constellation, O foremost of kings, / the very same should be given to its deity, and likewise to its direction; there is no doubt about this.

1.101.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhuvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate ..
ghṛtāktairakṣatairhomaḥ kāryyaśca satilairbhavet ..1..
1.101.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
धुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां महीपते ॥
घृताक्तैरक्षतैर्होमः कार्य्यश्च सतिलैर्भवेत् ॥1॥
1.101.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / For the deities situated in the Pole Star's abode, O king, / an oblation of unbroken grains smeared with clarified butter, along with sesame seeds, should be performed.

1.101.s:
arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadiraścāpāmārgo 'tha pippalaḥ ..
udumbaraśśamīdūrvāḥ kuśāśceti yathākramam .. 2 ..
1.101.d:
अर्कः पलाशः खदिरश्चापामार्गो ऽथ पिप्पलः ॥
उदुम्बरश्शमीदूर्वाः कुशाश्चेति यथाक्रमम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.101.m: Arka, palāśa, khadira, and apāmārga, then pippala, / udumbara, śamī, dūrvā, and kuśa grass in proper order,

1.101.s:
samidarthaṃ praśasyante sūryādīnāṃ narādhipa ..
hotavyāssamidhaścaiva ghṛtāktā manujeśvara .. 3 ..
1.101.d:
समिदर्थं प्रशस्यन्ते सूर्यादीनां नराधिप ॥
होतव्यास्समिधश्चैव घृताक्ता मनुजेश्वर ॥ 3 ॥
1.101.m: are commended as kindling sticks for the Sun and the others, O ruler of men; / and the kindling sticks should be offered smeared with clarified butter, O lord of men,

1.101.s:
tathā prādeśamātrāśca prāgagrā nityameva ca ..
ūrdhvaśuṣkāḥ sapatrāśca vitvacaśca vivarjayet .. 4 ..
1.101.d:
तथा प्रादेशमात्राश्च प्रागग्रा नित्यमेव च ॥
ऊर्ध्वशुष्काः सपत्राश्च वित्वचश्च विवर्जयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
1.101.m: measuring a span, and always with their tips turned to the east; / one should avoid those dried at the top, leafy, and stripped of bark.

1.101.s:
kṛttikānāṃ ghṛtenākto homaḥ pārthivasattama ..
rohiṇīnāṃ tathā bījairilvilānāṃ ca pāyasaiḥ .. 5 ..
1.101.d:
कृत्तिकानां घृतेनाक्तो होमः पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
रोहिणीनां तथा बीजैरिल्विलानां च पायसैः ॥ 5 ॥
1.101.m: The oblation for the Kṛttikās is smeared with clarified butter, O best of kings; / for Rohiṇī with seeds, and for Ilvalā with milk-rice;

1.101.s:
mākṣikaiśca tathārdrāyāmādityasya ca taṇḍulaiḥ ..
puṣyasya pāyasenāpi sārpa sya ca tathauṣadhaiḥ ..6..
1.101.d:
माक्षिकैश्च तथार्द्रायामादित्यस्य च तण्डुलैः ॥
पुष्यस्य पायसेनापि सार्प स्य च तथौषधैः ॥6॥
1.101.m: and with honey for Ārdrā, and with husked rice for Āditya; / with milk-rice for Puṣya, and likewise with medicinal herbs for Āśleṣā;

1.101.s:
tilaiḥ sataṇḍulairhomaḥ tathā paitryasya kīrtitaḥ ..
priyaṅgubhiśca bhāgyasya cāryyamṇasya tathākṣataiḥ .. 7 ..
1.101.d:
तिलैः सतण्डुलैर्होमः तथा पैत्र्यस्य कीर्तितः ॥
प्रियङ्गुभिश्च भाग्यस्य चार्य्यम्णस्य तथाक्षतैः ॥ 7 ॥
1.101.m: an oblation with sesame seeds together with husked rice is declared for the Pitṛs; / with priyaṅgu grains for Bhaga, and likewise with unbroken grains for Aryaman;

1.101.s:
sāvitrasya tathā dadhnā citrāyā pāyasena ca ..
vāyavyasyākṣataiḥ kāryyā saghṛtairmanujeśvara ..8..
1.101.d:
सावित्रस्य तथा दध्ना चित्राया पायसेन च ॥
वायव्यस्याक्षतैः कार्य्या सघृतैर्मनुजेश्वर ॥8॥
1.101.m: likewise with curd for Savitṛ, and with milk-rice for Citrā; / for the wind-deity, it should be done with unbroken grains along with clarified butter, O lord of men;

1.101.s:
aindrāgnasya sadā kāryyo yāvakena tathaiva ca ..
masūraiścaiva maitrasya śākrasya caṇakena tu .. 9 ..
1.101.d:
ऐन्द्राग्नस्य सदा कार्य्यो यावकेन तथैव च ॥
मसूरैश्चैव मैत्रस्य शाक्रस्य चणकेन तु ॥ 9 ॥
1.101.m: for Indra and Agni, it should always be done with barley-mash; / and with lentils for Mitra, and with chickpeas for Śakra;

1.101.s:
mūlasyauṣadhibhiḥ kāryyastathaivāpyasya śālibhiḥ ..
vaiśvadevasya payasā tathā brāhmasya pāyasaiḥ .. 1.101.10 ..
1.101.d:
मूलस्यौषधिभिः कार्य्यस्तथैवाप्यस्य शालिभिः ॥
वैश्वदेवस्य पयसा तथा ब्राह्मस्य पायसैः ॥ 1.101.10 ॥
1.101.m: for Mūla, it should be done with medicinal herbs, and likewise for the water-god with winter rice; / for the Viśvedevas with milk, and likewise for Brahmā with milk-rice;
for Śravaṇa, it is prescribed with gems along with husked rice; / for Indra, it is prescribed with fruits of the banyan and udumbara;

1.101.s:
vāruṇasyodakaiḥ puṣpaistathā caivākṣataiśśubhaiḥ ..
ājasyājyena madhunā dadhnā ca nṛpasattama .. 12 ..
1.101.d:
वारुणस्योदकैः पुष्पैस्तथा चैवाक्षतैश्शुभैः ॥
आजस्याज्येन मधुना दध्ना च नृपसत्तम ॥ 12 ॥
1.101.m: for Varuṇa, with waters, flowers, and auspicious unbroken grains; / for Aja, with clarified butter, honey, and curd, O best of kings;

1.101.s:
vrīhībhiśca tathā kāryyāścāhirbudhnyasya pārthiva ..
phalaiśca sākṣataiḥ kāryyastathā pauṣṇasya pārthiva..13..
1.101.d:
व्रीहीभिश्च तथा कार्य्याश्चाहिर्बुध्न्यस्य पार्थिव ॥
फलैश्च साक्षतैः कार्य्यस्तथा पौष्णस्य पार्थिव॥13॥
1.101.m: and for Ahirbudhnya, it should be done with paddy grains, O king; / and for Pūṣan, it should be done with fruits accompanied by unbroken grains, O king;

1.101.s:
kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhiśca āśvinasya vidhīyate ..
yāmyasya madhusaṃyuktaistilaiḥ pārthivasattama .. 14 ..
1.101.d:
क्षीरवृक्षसमिद्भिश्च आश्विनस्य विधीयते ॥
याम्यस्य मधुसंयुक्तैस्तिलैः पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 14 ॥
1.101.m: for the Aśvins, it is prescribed with kindling sticks from milky trees; / for Yama, with sesame seeds combined with honey, O best of kings.

1.101.s:
ājya tilāśca tailaṃ ca kṛśaraṃ madhu pāyasam ..
dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ prācyādīnāṃ yathākramam .. 15 ..
1.101.d:
आज्य तिलाश्च तैलं च कृशरं मधु पायसम् ॥
दधि क्षीरं घृतं क्षौद्रं प्राच्यादीनां यथाक्रमम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.101.m: Clarified butter, sesame seeds, sesame oil, rice and pulse dish, honey, milk-rice, / curd, milk, clarified butter, and honey [are the oblations] for the eastern and other directions in order.

1.101.s:
sāgarāṇāṃ ca payasā homaḥ kāryaḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
uktālābhe ca sarveṣāṃ homaḥ kāryyasti lākṣataiḥ .. 16 ..
1.101.d:
सागराणां च पयसा होमः कार्यः पृथक्पृथक् ॥
उक्तालाभे च सर्वेषां होमः कार्य्यस्ति लाक्षतैः ॥ 16 ॥
1.101.m: And for the oceans, the oblation should be made separately with milk; / and if the stated items are unavailable, the oblation for all of them should be made with sesame seeds and unbroken grains

1.101.s:
saghṛtaiḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha dravyaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ..
prabhoḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate .. 17 ..
1.101.d:
सघृतैः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ द्रव्यशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् ॥
प्रभोः प्रथमकल्पस्य योऽनुकल्पेन वर्तते ॥ 17 ॥
1.101.m: accompanied by clarified butter, O best of kings; one should avoid stinginess regarding materials. / When able to perform the primary rule, he who resorts to a substitute,
for that evil-minded person there is no benefit in the next world.

1.101.s:
yadyadagrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti .. 19 ..
1.101.d:
यद्यदग्रहस्याभिहितं मयात्र ऋक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान ॥
तद्देवतायाश्च तथैव देयं दिशस्तथा नात्र विचारणास्ति ॥ 19 ॥
1.101.m: Whatever has been stated by me here for a planet or for a constellation, O foremost of kings, / the very same should be given to its deity, and likewise to its direction; there is no doubt about this.

1.102.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa homaḥ kāryo dhruvasya tu ..
ūrdhvo adhara ityeva dhruvāyāśca diśo bhavet .. 1 ..
1.102.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ध्रुवा द्यौरिति मन्त्रेण होमः कार्यो ध्रुवस्य तु ॥
ऊर्ध्वो अधर इत्येव ध्रुवायाश्च दिशो भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥
1.102.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The oblation for Dhruva should be performed with the mantra "dhruvā dyauḥ"; / and for the fixed direction, it should be with "ūrdhvo adharaḥ".

1.102.s:
brahmayajñānamityeṣa brahmaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
dyaustvā iti ca mantreṇa divaḥ kāryo mahīpate .. 2 ..
1.102.d:
ब्रह्मयज्ञानमित्येष ब्रह्मणः परिकीर्तितः ॥
द्यौस्त्वा इति च मन्त्रेण दिवः कार्यो महीपते ॥ 2 ॥
1.102.m: This mantra "brahma jajñānam" is proclaimed for Brahmā; / for Heaven it should be performed with the mantra "dyauṣ ṭvā", O king;

1.102.s:
pṛthivī divi cetyeva pṛthivyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
praṇavena ca śeṣasya cādhastācca tathā diśaḥ .. 3 ..
1.102.d:
पृथिवी दिवि चेत्येव पृथिव्याः परिकीर्तितः ॥
प्रणवेन च शेषस्य चाधस्ताच्च तथा दिशः ॥ 3 ॥
1.102.m: for Earth, it is proclaimed with "pṛthivī divi"; / and for Śeṣa, as well as for the lower direction, with the Praṇava.

1.102.s:
agnirmūrdheti mantro'yamagnaye parikīrtitaḥ ..
uduttamaṃ varuṇapāśaṃ mantroyaṃ varuṇasya tu .. 4 ..
1.102.d:
अग्निर्मूर्धेति मन्त्रोऽयमग्नये परिकीर्तितः ॥
उदुत्तमं वरुणपाशं मन्त्रोयं वरुणस्य तु ॥ 4 ॥
1.102.m: This mantra "agnir mūrdhā" is proclaimed for Agni; / and this mantra "ud uttamaṃ varuṇa pāśam" is for Varuṇa;

1.102.s:
praṇavaśca kumārasya tadviṣṇorviṣṇave bhavet ..
trātāramindraṃ śakrasya devyāśca praṇavo bhavet .. 5 ..
1.102.d:
प्रणवश्च कुमारस्य तद्विष्णोर्विष्णवे भवेत् ॥
त्रातारमिन्द्रं शक्रस्य देव्याश्च प्रणवो भवेत् ॥ 5 ॥
1.102.m: and the Praṇava is for Kumāra; "tad viṣṇoḥ" should be for Viṣṇu; / "trātāram indram" is for Śakra; and the Praṇava should be for the Goddess;

1.102.s:
prajāpate na tvadetā mantro'yaṃ syātprajāpateḥ ..
vināyakāya praṇavo viśvakarmeti cāpyatha .. 6 ..
1.102.d:
प्रजापते न त्वदेता मन्त्रोऽयं स्यात्प्रजापतेः ॥
विनायकाय प्रणवो विश्वकर्मेति चाप्यथ ॥ 6 ॥
1.102.m: "prajāpate na tvad etāni" should be the mantra for Prajāpati; / the Praṇava is for Vināyaka; and moreover, "viśvakarmā"

1.102.s:
mantraśca kathito rājansatataṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ ..
ākṛṣṇeti ca mantro'yamādityasya prakīrtitaḥ .. 7 ..
1.102.d:
मन्त्रश्च कथितो राजन्सततं विश्वकर्मणः ॥
आकृष्णेति च मन्त्रोऽयमादित्यस्य प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 7 ॥
1.102.m: is declared as the mantra constantly for Viśvakarman, O king; / and this mantra "ā kṛṣṇena" is proclaimed for the Sun;

1.102.s:
imaṃ deveti somasya agnirmūrdhā kujasya tu ..
udbudhyasvā budhasyāpi mantraḥ prokto nareśvara .. 8 ..
1.102.d:
इमं देवेति सोमस्य अग्निर्मूर्धा कुजस्य तु ॥
उद्बुध्यस्वा बुधस्यापि मन्त्रः प्रोक्तो नरेश्वर ॥ 8 ॥
1.102.m: "imaṃ devāḥ" is for Soma; and "agnir mūrdhā" is for Mars; / "ud budhyasva" is also declared as the mantra for Mercury, O ruler of men;

1.102.s:
bṛhaspate ati yadaryo mantra ukto bṛhaspateḥ ..
annātparisrutetyevaṃ mantraḥ śukrasya kīrtitaḥ .. 9 ..
1.102.d:
बृहस्पते अति यदर्यो मन्त्र उक्तो बृहस्पतेः ॥
अन्नात्परिस्रुतेत्येवं मन्त्रः शुक्रस्य कीर्तितः ॥ 9 ॥
1.102.m: "bṛhaspate ati yad aryaḥ" is stated as the mantra of Bṛhaspati; / "annāt parisrutaḥ" is declared as the mantra of Venus;

1.102.s:
śannodevīti saurasya kāṇḍātkāṇḍeti rāhave ..
ketuṃ kṛṇvanniti tathā mantra uktaśca ketave .. 1.102.10 ..
1.102.d:
शन्नोदेवीति सौरस्य काण्डात्काण्डेति राहवे ॥
केतुं कृण्वन्निति तथा मन्त्र उक्तश्च केतवे ॥ 1.102.10 ॥
1.102.m: "śaṃ no devīḥ" is for Saturn; "kāṇḍāt kāṇḍāt" is for Rāhu; / and "ketuṃ kṛṇvan" is stated as the mantra for Ketu;

1.102.s:
agnirmūrddhā kṛttikānāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ prajāpate ..
madhuvvāteti mantro'yamilvalānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ .. 11 ..
1.102.d:
अग्निर्मूर्द्धा कृत्तिकानां रोहिणीनां प्रजापते ॥
मधुव्वातेति मन्त्रोऽयमिल्वलानां प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 11 ॥
1.102.m: "agnir mūrdhā" is for the Kṛttikās; [the mantra of] Prajāpati is for Rohiṇī; / this mantra "madhu vātāḥ" is proclaimed for the Ilvalās;

1.102.s:
mṛḍano rudramārdrāyāḥ sutrāmāṇaṃ punarvasoḥ ..
tava śriyeti puṣyasya homamantro vidhīyate .. 12 ..
1.102.d:
मृडनो रुद्रमार्द्रायाः सुत्रामाणं पुनर्वसोः ॥
तव श्रियेति पुष्यस्य होममन्त्रो विधीयते ॥ 12 ॥
1.102.m: "mṛḍa no rudra" is for Ārdrā; "sutrāmāṇam" is for Punarvasu; / "tava śriyā" is prescribed as the oblation mantra for Puṣya;

1.102.s:
namo'stu sarpebhyaśceti mantraḥ sārpasya kīrtitaḥ ..
ahaṃ pitṝniti tathā mantraḥ pitryasya kīrtitaḥ .. 13 ..
1.102.d:
नमोऽस्तु सर्पेभ्यश्चेति मन्त्रः सार्पस्य कीर्तितः ॥
अहं पितॄनिति तथा मन्त्रः पित्र्यस्य कीर्तितः ॥ 13 ॥
1.102.m: "namo 'stu sarpebhyaḥ" is proclaimed as the mantra for Āśleṣā; / likewise "ahaṃ pitṝn" is proclaimed as the mantra for Maghā;

1.102.s:
sadāsugeti bhāgyasya tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
ete aryyamannityevamāryamṇasya ca nirdiśet .. 14 ..
1.102.d:
सदासुगेति भाग्यस्य तथा मन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
एते अर्य्यमन्नित्येवमार्यम्णस्य च निर्दिशेत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.102.m: "sadāsugaḥ" is proclaimed as the mantra for Pūrvaphalgunī; / one should assign "ete aryaman" for Uttaraphalgunī;

1.102.s:
sāvitrasya ca sāvitrī tvāṣṭrasya ya ime tathā..
vāyuragreti ca tathā vāyavyasya narādhipa .. 15..
1.102.d:
सावित्रस्य च सावित्री त्वाष्ट्रस्य य इमे तथा॥
वायुरग्रेति च तथा वायव्यस्य नराधिप ॥ 15॥
1.102.m: the Sāvitrī verse is for Hasta; and "ye ime" is for Citrā; / and likewise "vāyur agre" is for Svātī, O ruler of men.

1.102.s: indrāgnī rocanetyevamindrāgnasya prakīrtitaḥ.. 16..
1.102.d: इन्द्राग्नी रोचनेत्येवमिन्द्राग्नस्य प्रकीर्तितः॥ 16॥
1.102.m: "Indrāgnī rocanā" is thus proclaimed for the oblation to Indrāgni.

1.102.s:
mitrojaneti maitrasya homamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
indraḥ sutrāma iti ca śākrasya vasudhādhipa .. 17 ..
1.102.d:
मित्रोजनेति मैत्रस्य होममन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
इन्द्रः सुत्राम इति च शाक्रस्य वसुधाधिप ॥ 17 ॥
1.102.m: "Mitro janān" is proclaimed as the fire-offering mantra for the deity Mitra, / and "Indraḥ sutrāmā" for Śakra, O lord of the earth.

1.102.s:
yante devīti nirṛtiṃ mūlasya ca tathā bhavet ..
śanna āpastathāpyasya homamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 18 ..
1.102.d:
यन्ते देवीति निरृतिं मूलस्य च तथा भवेत् ॥
शन्न आपस्तथाप्यस्य होममन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 18 ॥
1.102.m: For Nirṛti and Mūla it should be "Yāṃ te devī", / and "Śaṃ na āpaḥ" is proclaimed as the fire-offering mantra for Apas.

1.102.s:
viśvedevīti vaiśvasya tathā ca vasudhādhipa ..
brahmayajñānamityevaṃ tathā brāhmasya nirdiśet .. 19 ..
1.102.d:
विश्वेदेवीति वैश्वस्य तथा च वसुधाधिप ॥
ब्रह्मयज्ञानमित्येवं तथा ब्राह्मस्य निर्दिशेत् ॥ 19 ॥
1.102.m: And "Viśve devāḥ" is for the Viśvedevas, O lord of the earth; / likewise, one should indicate "Brahma jajñānam" for Brahmā.

1.102.s:
vaṣaṭte viṣṇa ityevaṃ vaiṣṇavasya tathā bhavet ..
āme grahā bhavatyevaṃ vāsavasya prakīrtitaḥ .. 1.102.20 ..
1.102.d:
वषट्ते विष्ण इत्येवं वैष्णवस्य तथा भवेत् ॥
आमे ग्रहा भवत्येवं वासवस्य प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 1.102.20 ॥
1.102.m: "Vaṣaṭ te viṣṇo" should likewise be for Viṣṇu; / "Ā me grahāḥ" is thus proclaimed for the Vasus.

1.102.s:
imaṃ me varuṇetyevaṃ vāruṇasya tathā bhavet ..
upaprāgetimantreṇa homamājasya kārayet .. 21 ..
1.102.d:
इमं मे वरुणेत्येवं वारुणस्य तथा भवेत् ॥
उपप्रागेतिमन्त्रेण होममाजस्य कारयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
1.102.m: "Imaṃ me varuṇa" should likewise be for Varuṇa; / one should make the fire-offering for Aja Ekapād with the mantra "Upa prāgāt".

1.102.s:
mantraścāhirivetyevamāhirbudhnyasya kīrtitaḥ ..
prayādamiti mantreṇa aśvinasya prakīrtitaḥ .. 22 ..
1.102.d:
मन्त्रश्चाहिरिवेत्येवमाहिर्बुध्न्यस्य कीर्तितः ॥
प्रयादमिति मन्त्रेण अश्विनस्य प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 22 ॥
1.102.m: And the mantra "Ahir iva" is proclaimed for Ahirbudhnya; / with the mantra "Pra yādam", it is proclaimed for the Aśvins.

1.102.s:
yamo dādhāra pṛthivīṃ tathā yāmyasya kīrtitam ..
nakṣatradevatāhome mantrā ete prakīrtitāḥ .. 23 ..
1.102.d:
यमो दाधार पृथिवीं तथा याम्यस्य कीर्तितम् ॥
नक्षत्रदेवताहोमे मन्त्रा एते प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 23 ॥
1.102.m: "Yamo dādhāra pṛthivīm" is proclaimed for Yama; / these mantras are proclaimed for the fire-offering to the asterism deities.

1.102.s:
nakṣatradevatā tulyā digīśānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
praṇavena diśaḥ kāryastathā vaiśravaṇasya ca .. 24 ..
1.102.d:
नक्षत्रदेवता तुल्या दिगीशानां तथैव च ॥
प्रणवेन दिशः कार्यस्तथा वैश्रवणस्य च ॥ 24 ॥
1.102.m: The asterism deity is equivalent to the lord of the direction, and likewise / [the offering for] the directions and for Vaiśravaṇa should be made with the sacred syllable Oṃ.

1.102.s:
sāgarāṇāṃ ca rājendra pṛthageva vijānatā ..
ekacakreti vā dvyarcaṃ grahāṇāṃ ca narādhipa .. 25 ..
1.102.d:
सागराणां च राजेन्द्र पृथगेव विजानता ॥
एकचक्रेति वा द्व्यर्चं ग्रहाणां च नराधिप ॥ 25 ॥
1.102.m: And for the oceans, O foremost of kings, by one who knows them individually; / or the two-verse hymn beginning "Eka cakram" is for the planets, O lord of men,

1.102.s: samāgneti tathā dvyarca nakṣatrāṇāṃ vidhīyate .. 26 ..
1.102.d: समाग्नेति तथा द्व्यर्च नक्षत्राणां विधीयते ॥ 26 ॥
1.102.m: and the two-verse hymn "Sam āgnā" is prescribed for the asterisms.

1.102.s:
etāvadukto nṛpavarya tubhyaṃ homāśrayo mantragaṇo grahāṇām ..
hutena yenānaghamānavānāṃ kāmānabhīṣṭānpradiśanti loke .. 27 ..
1.102.d:
एतावदुक्तो नृपवर्य तुभ्यं होमाश्रयो मन्त्रगणो ग्रहाणाम् ॥
हुतेन येनानघमानवानां कामानभीष्टान्प्रदिशन्ति लोके ॥ 27 ॥
1.102.m: This collection of mantras resting upon the fire-offering for the planets has thus been spoken to you, O best of kings, / by the offering of which they bestow upon faultless men their desired wishes in the world.

1.103.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
dakṣiṇārthe pradātavyaṃ sarveṣāmeva kāñcanam .. 1 ..
1.103.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
दक्षिणार्थे प्रदातव्यं सर्वेषामेव काञ्चनम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.103.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / For all the deities stationed in fixed places, individually, / gold is to be given as the sacrificial fee.

1.103.s:
raktāṃ vatsayutāṃ dhenuṃ dadyādarkāya pārthiva ..
śaṅkhaṃ dadyānnarendreṇa dakṣiṇārthaṃ niśābhṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
1.103.d:
रक्तां वत्सयुतां धेनुं दद्यादर्काय पार्थिव ॥
शङ्खं दद्यान्नरेन्द्रेण दक्षिणार्थं निशाभृतः ॥ 2 ॥
1.103.m: A red cow along with her calf should be given to the sun, O king; / a conch shell should be given by the lord of men as a sacrificial fee for the moon.

1.103.s:
raktavarṇohyanaḍvām̐śca dātavyaḥ kṣitijasya tu ..
kāñcanīṃ svāṃ pratikṛtiṃ bālakrīḍanakāni ca .. 3 ..
1.103.d:
रक्तवर्णोह्यनड्वाम्̐श्च दातव्यः क्षितिजस्य तु ॥
काञ्चनीं स्वां प्रतिकृतिं बालक्रीडनकानि च ॥ 3 ॥
1.103.m: A red bull should indeed be given to Mars; / an image of oneself made of gold and children's toys,

1.103.s:
budhāya rājandeyāni dakṣiṇārthe viśeṣataḥ ..
kṣaumaṃ dukūlaṃ kārpāsavāsāṃsi gurave tathā .. 4 ..
1.103.d:
बुधाय राजन्देयानि दक्षिणार्थे विशेषतः ॥
क्षौमं दुकूलं कार्पासवासांसि गुरवे तथा ॥ 4 ॥
1.103.m: O king, should especially be given as a sacrificial fee for Mercury; / flax, fine silk, and cotton garments likewise for Jupiter.

1.103.s:
sitavarṇaṃ ca turagaṃ bhārgavāya pradāpayet ..
kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃ savatsāṃ ca dadyātsūryasutāya vai .. 5 ..
1.103.d:
सितवर्णं च तुरगं भार्गवाय प्रदापयेत् ॥
कृष्णां धेनुं सवत्सां च दद्यात्सूर्यसुताय वै ॥ 5 ॥
1.103.m: One should cause a white horse to be given to Venus; / and one should give a black cow with her calf to Saturn.

1.103.s:
uṣṇīṣaṃ lohadaṇḍaśca dātavyo nṛpa rāhave ..
chāgaśca ketave deyaṃ kutapaṃ ca narādhipa .. 6 ..
1.103.d:
उष्णीषं लोहदण्डश्च दातव्यो नृप राहवे ॥
छागश्च केतवे देयं कुतपं च नराधिप ॥ 6 ॥
1.103.m: A turban and an iron staff should be given to Rāhu, O king; / and a goat and an animal-hair blanket should be given to Ketu, O lord of men.

1.103.s:
kṛttikānāṃ tu kanakaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..
sarvabījāni deyāni rohiṇīnāṃ tathaiva ca .. 7 ..
1.103.d:
कृत्तिकानां तु कनकं दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥
सर्वबीजानि देयानि रोहिणीनां तथैव च ॥ 7 ॥
1.103.m: Gold should be given for Kṛttikā by one desiring prosperity; / all kinds of seeds should likewise be given for Rohiṇī.

1.103.s:
dogdhrīṃ dhenuñcelvalānāmanaḍvāhaṃ ca rāhave ..
ādityāya śubhaṃ vastraṃ puṇyāya kanakaṃ ghṛtam ..8..
1.103.d:
दोग्ध्रीं धेनुञ्चेल्वलानामनड्वाहं च राहवे ॥
आदित्याय शुभं वस्त्रं पुण्याय कनकं घृतम् ॥8॥
1.103.m: A milch cow for Ilvalā, and an ox for Ārdrā; / a beautiful garment for Punarvasu, and gold and clarified butter for Puṣya.

1.103.s:
sārpāya vṛṣabhaṃ dadyādrukmaśṛṅgaṃ mahīpate ..
pitryasya ca tilāndadyādvāyavyasya ca cāmaram ..9..
1.103.d:
सार्पाय वृषभं दद्याद्रुक्मशृङ्गं महीपते ॥
पित्र्यस्य च तिलान्दद्याद्वायव्यस्य च चामरम् ॥9॥
1.103.m: For Āśleṣā one should give a bull with gold-tipped horns, O protector of the earth; / for Maghā one should give sesame seeds, and a chowrie for Svātī.

1.103.s:
bhāgyasya deyā gandhāśca āryamṇasya ca kāñcanam ..
hastasya kuñjaraṃ dadyātkanakaṃ vā mahīpate ..1.103.10..
1.103.d:
भाग्यस्य देया गन्धाश्च आर्यम्णस्य च काञ्चनम् ॥
हस्तस्य कुञ्जरं दद्यात्कनकं वा महीपते ॥1.103.10॥
1.103.m: For Pūrvaphālgunī fragrances should be given, and gold for Uttaraphālgunī; / for Hasta one should give an elephant or gold, O protector of the earth.

1.103.s:
tvāṣṭrasya vṛṣabhaṃ dadyādaindrāgnasya narādhipa..
vastrāṇi caiva maitrasya śākrasya kanakaṃ tathā..11..
1.103.d:
त्वाष्ट्रस्य वृषभं दद्यादैन्द्राग्नस्य नराधिप॥
वस्त्राणि चैव मैत्रस्य शाक्रस्य कनकं तथा॥11॥
1.103.m: For Citrā one should give a bull, O lord of men, and for Viśākhā / garments, and likewise for Anurādhā, and gold for Jyeṣṭhā.

1.103.s:
dadyānmūlasya mūlāni phalāni vividhāni ca ..
āpyasya dadhipātrāṇi śakaṭaṃ vāsavasya ca..12..
1.103.d:
दद्यान्मूलस्य मूलानि फलानि विविधानि च ॥
आप्यस्य दधिपात्राणि शकटं वासवस्य च॥12॥
1.103.m: For Mūla one should give roots and various fruits; / for Pūrvāṣāḍhā vessels of curd, and a cart for Dhaniṣṭhā.

1.103.s:
tathā candanakāṣṭhañca vāruṇasya pradāpayet ..
ajamājasya dātavyamāhirbudhnyasya caudanam .. 13 ..
1.103.d:
तथा चन्दनकाष्ठञ्च वारुणस्य प्रदापयेत् ॥
अजमाजस्य दातव्यमाहिर्बुध्न्यस्य चौदनम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.103.m: Likewise, sandalwood should be given for Śatabhiṣaj; / a goat is to be given for Pūrvaproṣṭhapadā, and cooked rice for Uttaraproṣṭhapadā.

1.103.s:
dhenuṃ pauṣṇasya turagamāśvinasya tathaiva ca ..
tiladhenuñca yāmyasya dadyātpāpāpanuttaye .. 14 ..
1.103.d:
धेनुं पौष्णस्य तुरगमाश्विनस्य तथैव च ॥
तिलधेनुञ्च याम्यस्य दद्यात्पापापनुत्तये ॥ 14 ॥
1.103.m: A cow for Revatī, and likewise a horse for Aśvinī; / and one should give a cow made of sesame for Bharaṇī to remove sin.

1.103.s:
kuñjaraṃ ca tathaivoṣṭraṃ rathaṃ śakaṭameva ca ..
hayamaśvataraṃ caiva narayānaṃ ca pārthiva .. 15 ..
1.103.d:
कुञ्जरं च तथैवोष्ट्रं रथं शकटमेव च ॥
हयमश्वतरं चैव नरयानं च पार्थिव ॥ 15 ॥
1.103.m: An elephant and likewise a camel, a chariot and a cart, / a horse, a mule, and a litter, O king,

1.103.s:
prācyādīnāṃ kramāddadyāddakṣiṇāśca narādhipa ..
sāgarāṇāṃ ca dātavyaṃ kanakaṃ bhūridakṣiṇam .. 16 ..
1.103.d:
प्राच्यादीनां क्रमाद्दद्याद्दक्षिणाश्च नराधिप ॥
सागराणां च दातव्यं कनकं भूरिदक्षिणम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.103.m: one should give in order as sacrificial fees for the eastern and other directions, O lord of men; / and for the oceans, an abundant sacrificial fee of gold is to be given.

1.103.s:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahāṇāñca diśāśca manujeśvara ..
yaduktamatra taddeyaṃ devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 17 ..
1.103.d:
नक्षत्राणां ग्रहाणाञ्च दिशाश्च मनुजेश्वर ॥
यदुक्तमत्र तद्देयं देवतानां पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 17 ॥
1.103.m: For the asterisms, the planets, and the directions, O lord of men, / whatever is spoken here is to be given individually to each deity.

1.103.s:
uktābhāve ca dātavyā dhenuḥ pārthivasattama ..
pratyekasya mahābhāga śubhā kāṃsyopadohanā .. 18 ..
1.103.d:
उक्ताभावे च दातव्या धेनुः पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
प्रत्येकस्य महाभाग शुभा कांस्योपदोहना ॥ 18 ॥
1.103.m: And in the absence of what is specified, a cow is to be given, O best of kings; / for each one, O fortunate one, an auspicious cow with a bronze milking pail,

1.103.s:
dogdhrī savatsā śīlāḍhyā vastraratnopaśobhitā ..
rukmaśṛṅgaiḥ khurai raupyairmuktālāṃgūlabhūṣitā .. 19 ..
1.103.d:
दोग्ध्री सवत्सा शीलाढ्या वस्त्ररत्नोपशोभिता ॥
रुक्मशृङ्गैः खुरै रौप्यैर्मुक्तालांगूलभूषिता ॥ 19 ॥
1.103.m: a milch cow with calf, endowed with good nature, adorned with garments and gems, / with horns of gold, hooves of silver, and a tail decorated with pearls.

1.103.s:
tato visarjanaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā nṛpa ..
dadhikṣīraghṛtaprāyaṃ tathā trimadhurānvitam .. 1.103.20 ..
1.103.d:
ततो विसर्जनं कार्यं पूर्वोक्तविधिना नृप ॥
दधिक्षीरघृतप्रायं तथा त्रिमधुरान्वितम् ॥ 1.103.20 ॥
1.103.m: Then the formal dismissal should be performed according to the rule previously stated, O king; / with foods mostly of curd, milk, and clarified butter, and furnished with the three sweets,

1.103.s:
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā pratyekasya narādhipa ..
yathāśaktyā mahārāja teṣāṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇām ..
prayatastām̐śca yāceta pūjitānprīṇanaṃ budhaḥ .. 21 ..
1.103.d:
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या प्रत्येकस्य नराधिप ॥
यथाशक्त्या महाराज तेषां दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
प्रयतस्ताम्̐श्च याचेत पूजितान्प्रीणनं बुधः ॥ 21 ॥
1.103.m: one should feed the brahmins with devotion for each [deity], O lord of men; / according to one's capacity, O great king, one should give them a sacrificial fee; / and carefully, the wise man, having honoured them, should ask for their satisfaction.

1.103.s:
etāvaduktaṃ tava śāntikarma samastapāpapraśamāya rājan ..
karttavyametatprayatena śaktyā na vittaśāṭhyena na māyayā ca .. 22 ..
1.103.d:
एतावदुक्तं तव शान्तिकर्म समस्तपापप्रशमाय राजन् ॥
कर्त्तव्यमेतत्प्रयतेन शक्त्या न वित्तशाठ्येन न मायया च ॥ 22 ॥
1.103.m: This pacification rite has been explained to you for the quelling of all sins, O king; / this should be performed carefully according to one's ability, not with miserliness in wealth nor with deceit.

1.104.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
evaṃ śāntyavasāne tu yajamānasya yājakaḥ ..
hṛdi vinyasya darbhāgrānsthitānsve dakṣiṇe kare .. 1 ..
1.104.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
एवं शान्त्यवसाने तु यजमानस्य याजकः ॥
हृदि विन्यस्य दर्भाग्रान्स्थितान्स्वे दक्षिणे करे ॥ 1 ॥
1.104.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus, at the end of the pacification rite, the priest, / placing the tips of the darbha grass held in his own right hand upon the heart of the patron,

1.104.s:
kuryātpratisarābandhaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ..
baddhapratisarasyāsya sarve naśyantu rākṣasāḥ .. 2 ..
1.104.d:
कुर्यात्प्रतिसराबन्धं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
बद्धप्रतिसरस्यास्य सर्वे नश्यन्तु राक्षसाः ॥ 2 ॥
1.104.m: should perform the tying of the protective amulet string; listen to that as I speak it: / "May all rākṣasas perish for him who has tied the protective amulet string!

1.104.s:
dhruvastvāmūrdhvataḥ pātu pūrvataḥ pātu bhāskaraḥ ..
bhaumo dakṣiṇataḥ pātu paścātpātu śanaiścaraḥ .. 3 ..
1.104.d:
ध्रुवस्त्वामूर्ध्वतः पातु पूर्वतः पातु भास्करः ॥
भौमो दक्षिणतः पातु पश्चात्पातु शनैश्चरः ॥ 3 ॥
1.104.m: May Dhruva protect you from above; may the sun protect you from the east; / may Mars protect you from the south; may Saturn protect you from behind [the west];

1.104.s:
uttareṇa budhaḥ pātu ketuḥ pātu tathā hyadhaḥ ..
pūrvadakṣiṇataḥ śukro dakṣiṇāparatastamaḥ .. 4 ..
1.104.d:
उत्तरेण बुधः पातु केतुः पातु तथा ह्यधः ॥
पूर्वदक्षिणतः शुक्रो दक्षिणापरतस्तमः ॥ 4 ॥
1.104.m: may Mercury protect you from the north; may Ketu protect you indeed from below; / Venus from the south-east; Rāhu from the south-west;

1.104.s:
paścimottarataścandro jīvaḥ prāguttareṇa tu ..
uktasandhiṣu sarvāṇi nakṣatrāṇi tavānagha .. 5 ..
1.104.d:
पश्चिमोत्तरतश्चन्द्रो जीवः प्रागुत्तरेण तु ॥
उक्तसन्धिषु सर्वाणि नक्षत्राणि तवानघ ॥ 5 ॥
1.104.m: the moon from the north-west; and Jupiter from the north-east. / In the mentioned intermediate junctions, may all the asterisms [protect] you, O sinless one!

1.104.s:
svāṃsvāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya tava nityaṃ digīśvarāḥ ..
rakṣantu sarvaduṣṭebhyaḥ śakravahnipurogamāḥ .. 6 ..
1.104.d:
स्वांस्वां दिशमधिष्ठाय तव नित्यं दिगीश्वराः ॥
रक्षन्तु सर्वदुष्टेभ्यः शक्रवह्निपुरोगमाः ॥ 6 ॥
1.104.m: Presiding each over their own direction, may the lords of the directions, / led by Śakra and Agni, protect you constantly from all evil forces,

1.104.s:
śātravāṇāṃ ca corāṇāṃ vyādhīnāṃ pātakasya ca ..
amaṅgalānāṃ ghorāṇāmariṣṭānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 7 ..
1.104.d:
शात्रवाणां च चोराणां व्याधीनां पातकस्य च ॥
अमङ्गलानां घोराणामरिष्टानां तथैव च ॥ 7 ॥
1.104.m: and from enemies, thieves, diseases, and sins, / and likewise from dreadful inauspicious occurrences and portents of death,

1.104.s:
dussvapnānāṃ ca ghorāṇāṃ cintitānāṃ tathā mṛṣā..
vajreṇa nāśanaṃ śakraḥ karotu balasūdanaḥ .. 8 ..
1.104.d:
दुस्स्वप्नानां च घोराणां चिन्तितानां तथा मृषा॥
वज्रेण नाशनं शक्रः करोतु बलसूदनः ॥ 8 ॥
1.104.m: and terrible nightmares, and falsely imagined anxieties; / may Śakra, the slayer of Bala, destroy them with his thunderbolt.

1.104.s:
daṇḍena nāśanaṃ nityaṃ vidadhātu yamontakaḥ ..
pāśena varuṇo devo gadayā ca dhaneśvaraḥ .. 9 ..
1.104.d:
दण्डेन नाशनं नित्यं विदधातु यमोन्तकः ॥
पाशेन वरुणो देवो गदया च धनेश्वरः ॥ 9 ॥
1.104.m: May Yama, the Ender, constantly effect their destruction with his staff, / Lord Varuṇa with his noose, and the Lord of Wealth with his club.
Clad in the armour of the planets, stationed in the midst of the planetary cage, / invisible to all beings, freed from all suffering,

1.104.s:
sarvavyādhivihīnaśca kālakarṇīvivarjitaḥ ..
tathā tvaṃ bhava dīrghāyurgrahendrāṇāṃ prasādataḥ ..11..
1.104.d:
सर्वव्याधिविहीनश्च कालकर्णीविवर्जितः ॥
तथा त्वं भव दीर्घायुर्ग्रहेन्द्राणां प्रसादतः ॥11॥
1.104.m: rid of all disease, and free from the goddess of misfortune, / so may you be long-lived through the grace of the lords of the planets.

1.104.s:
rakṣantu te devagaṇāḥ samantrāḥ dharme matiṃ cāpi sadā diśantu ..
nāśaṃ tathā śatrugaṇasya cograṃ bhogānmanojñānvipulāśca lakṣmīm .. 12 ..
1.104.d:
रक्षन्तु ते देवगणाः समन्त्राः धर्मे मतिं चापि सदा दिशन्तु ॥
नाशं तथा शत्रुगणस्य चोग्रं भोगान्मनोज्ञान्विपुलाश्च लक्ष्मीम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.104.m: May the hosts of gods accompanied by mantras protect you, and may they always grant your mind [devotion] to dharma, / likewise the fierce destruction of the hosts of your enemies, enjoyable pleasures, and abundant fortune.

1.104.s: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śāntyavasāne pratisarabandhāśīrvādonāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 104 .. ..
1.104.d: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे शान्त्यवसाने प्रतिसरबन्धाशीर्वादोनाम चतुरधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 104 ॥ ॥
1.104.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fourth chapter, entitled 'The Blessing of Tying the Protective Thread at the Conclusion of the Pacification Ritual', in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the first book of the glorious Viṣṇudharmottara.

1.105.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
haviṣyāśī tatastiṣṭhedbrahmacārī ca tāṃ niśām ..
grahaśāntiriyaṃ proktā mayā kalmaṣanāśinī .. 1 ..
1.105.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
हविष्याशी ततस्तिष्ठेद्ब्रह्मचारी च तां निशाम् ॥
ग्रहशान्तिरियं प्रोक्ता मया कल्मषनाशिनी ॥ 1 ॥
1.105.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / He should then remain eating sacrificial food and celibate for that night. / This planetary pacification ritual, which destroys sins, has been proclaimed by me.

1.105.s:
anāvṛṣṭyāṃ prayoktavyā vṛṣṭikāmena bhūbhujā ..
ativṛṣṭyāṃ prayoktavyā vṛṣṭiṃ śamayatā tathā .. 2 ..
1.105.d:
अनावृष्ट्यां प्रयोक्तव्या वृष्टिकामेन भूभुजा ॥
अतिवृष्ट्यां प्रयोक्तव्या वृष्टिं शमयता तथा ॥ 2 ॥
1.105.m: It should be performed during a drought by a king desiring rain; / it should likewise be performed during excessive rain by one appeasing the rain;

1.105.s:
yātrākāle tathā kāryyā ripūṇāṃ kṣayamicchatā ..
raṇakāle tathā kāryyā saṃgrāme jayamicchatā .. 3 ..
1.105.d:
यात्राकाले तथा कार्य्या रिपूणां क्षयमिच्छता ॥
रणकाले तथा कार्य्या संग्रामे जयमिच्छता ॥ 3 ॥
1.105.m: it should likewise be performed at the time of marching by one desiring the destruction of enemies; / it should likewise be performed at the time of battle by one desiring victory in warfare;

1.105.s:
kartavyā cābhicārārthaṃ śatrūṇāṃ manujeśvara ..
puṣṭikāmairnaraiḥ kāryyā vidyākāmaistathaiva ca .. 4 ..
1.105.d:
कर्तव्या चाभिचारार्थं शत्रूणां मनुजेश्वर ॥
पुष्टिकामैर्नरैः कार्य्या विद्याकामैस्तथैव च ॥ 4 ॥
1.105.m: and it should be performed for the sorcery [directed against] enemies, O lord of men. / It should be performed by men desiring prosperity, and likewise by those desiring learning;

1.105.s:
lābhārthaṃ ca tathā vaiśyaiḥ śūdrairdharmmaphalepsubhiḥ ..
rājyakāmena kartavyā rājaputreṇa pārthiva .. 5 ..
1.105.d:
लाभार्थं च तथा वैश्यैः शूद्रैर्धर्म्मफलेप्सुभिः ॥
राज्यकामेन कर्तव्या राजपुत्रेण पार्थिव ॥ 5 ॥
1.105.m: and likewise by vaiśyas for gain, and by śūdras desiring the fruit of dharma; / it should be performed by a prince desiring kingship, O ruler;

1.105.s:
tathā vandhanamokṣārthaṃ baddhena ca mahīpate ..
sthānacyutena kartavyā sthānalabdhimathecchatā .. 6 ..
1.105.d:
तथा वन्धनमोक्षार्थं बद्धेन च महीपते ॥
स्थानच्युतेन कर्तव्या स्थानलब्धिमथेच्छता ॥ 6 ॥
1.105.m: likewise by one who is bound, O king, for release from bondage; / it should be performed by one fallen from his post who desires to regain his position;

1.105.s:
vyādhitena ca kartavyā vyādheḥ praśamamicchatā ..
mārake ca tathā kāryā mārakakṣayamicchatā .. 7 ..
1.105.d:
व्याधितेन च कर्तव्या व्याधेः प्रशममिच्छता ॥
मारके च तथा कार्या मारकक्षयमिच्छता ॥ 7 ॥
1.105.m: and it should be performed by one who is diseased who desires the alleviation of his disease; / and it should likewise be performed during a pestilence by one desiring the destruction of the pestilence.
Upon suspicion of sorcery by others, one should employ the planetary pacification ritual, / and likewise at the occurrence of portents that are celestial, atmospheric, and terrestrial.

1.105.s:
grahādhīnāṃ narendrāṇāmucchrāyāḥ patanāni ca ..
bhāvābhāvau ca jagatāṃ grahāyattau narādhipa .. 9 ..
1.105.d:
ग्रहाधीनां नरेन्द्राणामुच्छ्रायाः पतनानि च ॥
भावाभावौ च जगतां ग्रहायत्तौ नराधिप ॥ 9 ॥
1.105.m: Dependent upon the planets are the ascents and the falls of kings, / and the existence and non-existence of the worlds depend upon the planets, O lord of men.

1.105.s:
brahmaṇaiṣāṃ varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjayiṣyatha ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena nṛṇāṃ pūjyatamā grahāḥ .. 1.105.10 ..
1.105.d:
ब्रह्मणैषां वरो दत्तः पूजिताः पूजयिष्यथ ॥
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन नृणां पूज्यतमा ग्रहाः ॥ 1.105.10 ॥
1.105.m: A boon was granted to them by Brahmā: 'When worshiped, you shall worship [in return]'; / therefore, with all effort, the planets are most worthy of worship by men.

1.105.s:
gurubhaktasya dāntasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca ..
pūjakasya grahendrāṇāṃ sadā sānugrahā grahāḥ ..11..
1.105.d:
गुरुभक्तस्य दान्तस्य धर्मार्जितधनस्य च ॥
पूजकस्य ग्रहेन्द्राणां सदा सानुग्रहा ग्रहाः ॥11॥
1.105.m: To one devoted to the guru, self-controlled, who has acquired wealth through dharma, / and worships the lords of the planets, the planets are always gracious.

1.105.s:
mānavasyāsvatantrasya gobrāhmaṇahitasya ca ..
māṃsabhakṣaṇahīnasya sadā sānugrahā grahāḥ .. 12 ..
1.105.d:
मानवस्यास्वतन्त्रस्य गोब्राह्मणहितस्य च ॥
मांसभक्षणहीनस्य सदा सानुग्रहा ग्रहाः ॥ 12 ॥
1.105.m: To a person who is dependent, devoted to the welfare of cows and brahmins, / and refrains from eating meat, the planets are always gracious.

1.105.s:
ye bhaktāḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam ..
nāsti teṣāṃ jagatyasmindoṣo grahakṛto nṛṇām .. 13 ..
1.105.d:
ये भक्ताः पुण्डरीकाक्षं देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ॥
नास्ति तेषां जगत्यस्मिन्दोषो ग्रहकृतो नृणाम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.105.m: Those men who are devoted to Janārdana, the lotus-eyed god of gods— / for them there is no affliction caused by the planets in this world.

1.105.s:
yathā bāṇaprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ bhaveta ..
tathā daivopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati vāraṇam ..14..
1.105.d:
यथा बाणप्रहाराणां कवचं वारणं भवेत ॥
तथा दैवोपघातानां शान्तिर्भवति वारणम् ॥14॥
1.105.m: Just as armour is a protection against strikes of arrows, / so a pacification ritual is a protection against strokes of fate.

1.105.s:
grahayāgavidhiṃ samyagyaścādhīte narādhipa ..
grahapākitaṃ caiva tasyāpi na bhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
1.105.d:
ग्रहयागविधिं सम्यग्यश्चाधीते नराधिप ॥
ग्रहपाकितं चैव तस्यापि न भविष्यति ॥ 15 ॥
1.105.m: And whoever properly recites the rite of the planetary sacrifice, O lord of men, / to him also no affliction brought about by the planets shall happen.

1.105.s:
atīva vistareṇeyaṃ grahaśāṃtirudāhṛtā ..
dhanyā yaśasyā cāyuṣyā sarvakilbiṣanāśinī .. 16 ..
1.105.d:
अतीव विस्तरेणेयं ग्रहशांतिरुदाहृता ॥
धन्या यशस्या चायुष्या सर्वकिल्बिषनाशिनी ॥ 16 ॥
1.105.m: This planetary pacification ritual has been declared in great detail; / it bestows fortune, fame, and long life, and destroys all sins.

1.105.s:
prayuñjataḥ samyagimāṃ narendra na jātu loke bhayamasti kiñcit ..
ārogyamāsādya ciraṃ ca jīvetprāpnoti lakṣmīṃ sakalām̐śca bhogān .. 17 ..
1.105.d:
प्रयुञ्जतः सम्यगिमां नरेन्द्र न जातु लोके भयमस्ति किञ्चित् ॥
आरोग्यमासाद्य चिरं च जीवेत्प्राप्नोति लक्ष्मीं सकलाम्̐श्च भोगान् ॥ 17 ॥
1.105.m: For one who properly performs this, O king, there is never any fear in the world; / having obtained health, he will live long, and he attains fortune and all pleasures.

1.106.s:
.. vajra uvāca ..
dhruvasyāhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha brāhmaṇānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
sambhavaṃ śrotumicchāmi nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca mānada.. 1 ..
1.106.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
ध्रुवस्याहं द्विजश्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणानां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
सम्भवं श्रोतुमिच्छामि नक्षत्राणां च मानद॥ 1 ॥
1.106.m: Vajra said: / O best of the twice-born, one who confers honor, I wish to hear individually / the origin of Dhruva, of the stars, and of the nakṣatras.

1.106.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
brahmaṇā sṛṣṭikāmena pūrvameva narādhipa ..
ādityastamasāṃ hantā tejasāṃ golakaḥ kṛtaḥ ..2..
1.106.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ब्रह्मणा सृष्टिकामेन पूर्वमेव नराधिप ॥
आदित्यस्तमसां हन्ता तेजसां गोलकः कृतः ॥2॥
1.106.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Long ago, O ruler of men, by Brahmā desiring to create, / the sun, the destroyer of darkness, was made as a globe of light.

1.106.s:
tamomayo golakaśca rāhustena tathā kṛtaḥ ..
ammayāni tathānyāni golakāni narādhipa...
kṛtāni tena dharmmajña graharkṣāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭāśca tārakāśca caturdaśa .. 4 ..
1.106.d:
तमोमयो गोलकश्च राहुस्तेन तथा कृतः ॥
अम्मयानि तथान्यानि गोलकानि नराधिप॥।
कृतानि तेन धर्म्मज्ञ ग्रहर्क्षाणां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टाश्च तारकाश्च चतुर्दश ॥ 4 ॥
1.106.m: And Rāhu was likewise made by him as a globe consisting of darkness; / likewise other globes, O ruler of men, / consisting of water, were made individually by him, O knower of dharma, for the planets and asterisms; / and fourteen stars were situated in the station of Dhruva.

1.106.s:
teṣāṃ nāmavibhāgaṃ me gadataḥ śṛṇu pārthiva ..
uttānapādastasyātha vijñeyaḥ sottaro hanuḥ .. 5 ..
1.106.d:
तेषां नामविभागं मे गदतः शृणु पार्थिव ॥
उत्तानपादस्तस्याथ विज्ञेयः सोत्तरो हनुः ॥ 5 ॥
1.106.m: Hear from me as I tell the distribution of their names, O king: / Uttānapāda is to be known as its upper jaw;

1.106.s:
yajño'dharastu vijñeyo dharmo mūrdhānamāśritaḥ ..
hṛdi nārāyaṇaḥ sādhyāvaśvinau pūrvapādayoḥ .. 6 ..
1.106.d:
यज्ञोऽधरस्तु विज्ञेयो धर्मो मूर्धानमाश्रितः ॥
हृदि नारायणः साध्यावश्विनौ पूर्वपादयोः ॥ 6 ॥
1.106.m: Yajña is to be known as the lower [jaw]; Dharma rests upon the head; / Nārāyaṇa is in the heart; the Sādhyas and the Aśvins are in the two forelegs;

1.106.s:
varuṇaścāryamā tasya paścime caiva sakthinī ..
śiśnaḥ saṃvatsarastasya mitro'pānaṃ samāśritaḥ .. 7 ..
1.106.d:
वरुणश्चार्यमा तस्य पश्चिमे चैव सक्थिनी ॥
शिश्नः संवत्सरस्तस्य मित्रोऽपानं समाश्रितः ॥ 7 ॥
1.106.m: Varuṇa and Aryaman are indeed in its two hind legs; / the Year is its penis; Mitra rests upon the anus;

1.106.s:
pucchegniśca mahendraśca mārīcaḥ kaśyapo dhruvaḥ ..
dhuvasthāsnurgraharkṣāṇāmmeḍhībhūtaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 8 ..
1.106.d:
पुच्छेग्निश्च महेन्द्रश्च मारीचः कश्यपो ध्रुवः ॥
धुवस्थास्नुर्ग्रहर्क्षाणाम्मेढीभूतः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 8 ॥
1.106.m: Agni, Mahendra, Kaśyapa the son of Marīci, and Dhruva are in the tail; / standing in the station of Dhruva, it is declared to be the pivot of the planets and asterisms.

1.106.s:
dhruveṇa bhrāmyate sarvamāyattaṃ tridive dhruve ..
dhruvo hi bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ .. 9 ..
1.106.d:
ध्रुवेण भ्राम्यते सर्वमायत्तं त्रिदिवे ध्रुवे ॥
ध्रुवो हि भगवान्विष्णुः कालो लोकप्रकालनः ॥ 9 ॥
1.106.m: Everything is caused to revolve by Dhruva; everything in heaven is dependent on Dhruva; / for Dhruva is Lord Viṣṇu, Time, the driver of the world.

1.106.s:
śiśumāranibaddhānāṃ tārakāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
nāmadheyāni vijñāya dṛṣṭvā ca vimale'mbare .. 1.106.10 ..
1.106.d:
शिशुमारनिबद्धानां तारकाणां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
नामधेयानि विज्ञाय दृष्ट्वा च विमलेऽम्बरे ॥ 1.106.10 ॥
1.106.m: Having known the individual names of the stars fixed in the Śiśumāra [constellation], / and having seen them in the clear sky,

1.106.s:
āyurabhyadhikaṃ jīvedvarṣāṇi tu caturdaśa ..
ahorātrakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇādeva mucyate .. 11 ..
1.106.d:
आयुरभ्यधिकं जीवेद्वर्षाणि तु चतुर्दश ॥
अहोरात्रकृतात्पापात्तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते ॥ 11 ॥
1.106.m: one lives an additional fourteen years of life; / and one is freed that very moment from sin committed during a day and night.

1.106.s:
āmmayānāṃ graharkṣāṇāṃ mūrcchitāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ ..
janayanti prakāśatvaṃ nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā .. 12 ..
1.106.d:
आम्मयानां ग्रहर्क्षाणां मूर्च्छिताः सूर्यरश्मयः ॥
जनयन्ति प्रकाशत्वं नात्र कार्य्या विचारणा ॥ 12 ॥
1.106.m: The rays of the sun, intensified upon the watery planets and asterisms, / produce radiance; no doubt should be entertained here.

1.106.s:
sphāṭikāni vimānāni tathā sukṛtināṃ nṛpa ..
nāke tārakabaddhāni ammayānīva yādava .. 13 ..
1.106.d:
स्फाटिकानि विमानानि तथा सुकृतिनां नृप ॥
नाके तारकबद्धानि अम्मयानीव यादव ॥ 13 ॥
1.106.m: Likewise, the crystal aerial cars of those who performed good deeds, O king, / are fixed among the stars in heaven, as if made of water, O descendant of Yadu.

1.106.s:
graharkṣāṇi samastāni dhruvaśca bhagavāṃstathā ..
kalpasthāyīni rājendra nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā .. .. 14 ..
1.106.d:
ग्रहर्क्षाणि समस्तानि ध्रुवश्च भगवांस्तथा ॥
कल्पस्थायीनि राजेन्द्र नात्र कार्य्या विचारणा ॥ ॥ 14 ॥
1.106.m: All the planets and asterisms, and likewise the venerable Dhruva, / endure for an aeon, O best of kings; no doubt should be entertained here.

1.106.s:
teṣāṃ tadabhimāninyo devatā yadunandana ..
manvantarādau jāyante na bhavanti punaḥpunaḥ .. 15 ..
1.106.d:
तेषां तदभिमानिन्यो देवता यदुनन्दन ॥
मन्वन्तरादौ जायन्ते न भवन्ति पुनःपुनः ॥ 15 ॥
1.106.m: Their presiding deities, O joy of the Yadus, / are born at the beginning of a manvantara; they do not appear repeatedly.

1.106.s:
auttānapādirdhamātmā dhruvasteṣvapi yādava ..
svāyambhuventare jātastiṣṭhatyābhūtasaṃplavam .. 16 ..
1.106.d:
औत्तानपादिर्धमात्मा ध्रुवस्तेष्वपि यादव ॥
स्वायम्भुवेन्तरे जातस्तिष्ठत्याभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.106.m: Dhruva, the son of Uttānapāda, righteous in soul, among them, O descendant of Yadu, / born in the interval of Svāyambhuva, remains until the dissolution of beings.

1.106.s:
tasya te janma vakṣyāmi sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ..
pūrvaṃ brahmā mahīpāla sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ .. 17 ..
1.106.d:
तस्य ते जन्म वक्ष्यामि सर्वकल्मषनाशनम् ॥
पूर्वं ब्रह्मा महीपाल सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः ॥ 17 ॥
1.106.m: I shall tell you of his birth, which destroys all sins: / Formerly, O king, Brahmā, desiring to create various creatures,

1.106.s:
dvidhā kṛtvātmano dehamardhena puruṣo'bhavat ..
ardhena nārī tasyāsīdvirājamasṛjatprabhuḥ .. 18 ..
1.106.d:
द्विधा कृत्वात्मनो देहमर्धेन पुरुषोऽभवत् ॥
अर्धेन नारी तस्यासीद्विराजमसृजत्प्रभुः ॥ 18 ॥
1.106.m: divided his body in two; with one half he became a man, / and with one half a woman; from her the Lord created Virāj.

1.106.s:
virāḍasṛjatpuruṣaṃ puruṣo manurucyate ..
yasyaikasaptatiguṇaṃ manvantaramihocyate .. 19 ..
1.106.d:
विराडसृजत्पुरुषं पुरुषो मनुरुच्यते ॥
यस्यैकसप्ततिगुणं मन्वन्तरमिहोच्यते ॥ 19 ॥
1.106.m: Virāj created the Man; that Man is called Manu, / whose manvantara is declared here to consist of seventy-one [cycles].

1.106.s:
priyavratottānapādau manoḥ putrāvubhau smṛtau ..
kṣatrapravarttakau tau tu pūrve manvantare smṛtau .. 1.106.20 ..
1.106.d:
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ मनोः पुत्रावुभौ स्मृतौ ॥
क्षत्रप्रवर्त्तकौ तौ तु पूर्वे मन्वन्तरे स्मृतौ ॥ 1.106.20 ॥
1.106.m: Priyavrata and Uttānapāda are known as the two sons of Manu; / they are remembered as the founders of the kṣatriya lineage in the first manvantara.

1.106.s:
uttānapādaputrastu dhruvo viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
nibaddho bhrāmyate yatra marutāṃ jyotiṣāṃ gaṇaḥ .. 21 ..
1.106.d:
उत्तानपादपुत्रस्तु ध्रुवो विष्णुः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
निबद्धो भ्राम्यते यत्र मरुतां ज्योतिषां गणः ॥ 21 ॥
1.106.m: The son of Uttānapāda is Dhruva, celebrated as Viṣṇu, / to whom is bound and revolves the host of luminous bodies and winds.

1.106.s:
saptarṣi maṇḍalaṃ nityaṃ tasyādhastātprakīrtitam ..
marīciśca vasiṣṭhaśca aṅgirāścātrireva ca .. 22 ..
1.106.d:
सप्तर्षि मण्डलं नित्यं तस्याधस्तात्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
मरीचिश्च वसिष्ठश्च अङ्गिराश्चात्रिरेव च ॥ 22 ॥
1.106.m: Beneath him is perpetually proclaimed the circle of the Seven Sages: / Marīci, Vasiṣṭha, Aṅgiras, and Atri,

1.106.s:
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kratussaptarṣayo'malāḥ ..
vaśiṣṭhamāśritā sādhvī teṣāmmadhyādarundhatī .. 23 ..
1.106.d:
पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव क्रतुस्सप्तर्षयोऽमलाः ॥
वशिष्ठमाश्रिता साध्वी तेषाम्मध्यादरुन्धती ॥ 23 ॥
1.106.m: Pulastya, Pulaha, and Kratu are the spotless Seven Sages; / and from among them, the virtuous Arundhatī remains devoted to Vasiṣṭha.

1.106.s:
tasyādhastādbhacakrañca tasyādhastācchanaiścaraḥ ..
tasyādhastāttathā jīvastasyādhastātkujaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 24 ..
1.106.d:
तस्याधस्ताद्भचक्रञ्च तस्याधस्ताच्छनैश्चरः ॥
तस्याधस्तात्तथा जीवस्तस्याधस्तात्कुजः स्मृतः ॥ 24 ॥
1.106.m: Beneath that is the circle of constellations, and beneath that is Saturn; / beneath that is Jupiter, and beneath that Mars is remembered.

1.106.s:
tasyādhastāddineśaśca tasyādhastācca bhārgavaḥ ..
tasyādhastādbudhaḥ proktastasyādhastācca candramāḥ .. .. 25 ..
1.106.d:
तस्याधस्ताद्दिनेशश्च तस्याधस्ताच्च भार्गवः ॥
तस्याधस्ताद्बुधः प्रोक्तस्तस्याधस्ताच्च चन्द्रमाः ॥ ॥ 25 ॥
1.106.m: Beneath that is the lord of day, and beneath that Venus; / beneath that Mercury is spoken of, and beneath that the Moon.

1.106.s:
prāgdakṣiṇagatiścaiva jyotiṣāṃ cakramucyate ..
sarve grahāḥ prāggatayastulyavegāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 26 ..
1.106.d:
प्राग्दक्षिणगतिश्चैव ज्योतिषां चक्रमुच्यते ॥
सर्वे ग्रहाः प्राग्गतयस्तुल्यवेगाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 26 ॥
1.106.m: The wheel of luminous bodies is said to have an eastward and southward motion; / all planets are proclaimed to move eastward with equal velocity.

1.106.s:
śīghratvenopacaryante yathā sannaṃ mahīpate ..
yathā yathā viśiṣṭāśca tathā mandāḥ prakīrttitāḥ .. 27 ..
1.106.d:
शीघ्रत्वेनोपचर्यन्ते यथा सन्नं महीपते ॥
यथा यथा विशिष्टाश्च तथा मन्दाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः ॥ 27 ॥
1.106.m: They are figuratively spoken of as fast according to their proximity [to the earth], O lord of the earth; / and the further out they are, the slower they are declared to be.

1.106.s:
teṣāṃ te sambhavaṃ vakṣye prāpte vaivasvate'ntare ..
teṣāṃ jananasāhasrairatītaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam .. 28 ..
1.106.d:
तेषां ते सम्भवं वक्ष्ये प्राप्ते वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे ॥
तेषां जननसाहस्रैरतीतैः किं प्रयोजनम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.106.m: I shall tell you of their origin when the interval of Vaivasvata arrived; / what need is there for thousands of their past births?

1.106.s:
anādinidhanaḥ śrīmānviṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ..
sa eva devakāryārthaṃ bhūtvā dvādaśadhā purā .. 29 ..
1.106.d:
अनादिनिधनः श्रीमान्विष्णुर्नारायणः प्रभुः ॥
स एव देवकार्यार्थं भूत्वा द्वादशधा पुरा ॥ 29 ॥
1.106.m: The glorious Lord Viṣṇu Nārāyaṇa is without beginning or end; / having previously assumed twelve forms for the sake of the gods' affairs,

1.106.s:
aditerjanayāmāsa hyātmānaṃ kaśyapātprabhuḥ ..
teṣāṃ tu madhyātsavitā ādityasya ca devatā .. 1.106.30..
1.106.d:
अदितेर्जनयामास ह्यात्मानं कश्यपात्प्रभुः ॥
तेषां तु मध्यात्सविता आदित्यस्य च देवता ॥ 1.106.30॥
1.106.m: the Lord begot himself from Kaśyapa upon Aditi. / From among them, Savitṛ is the deity of the sun.

1.106.s:
proktaṃ te saviturjanma śṛṇu candramasastataḥ ..
daśabhyaśca diśābhyaśca tathātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ .. 31 ..
1.106.d:
प्रोक्तं ते सवितुर्जन्म शृणु चन्द्रमसस्ततः ॥
दशभ्यश्च दिशाभ्यश्च तथात्रेः सुमहात्मनः ॥ 31 ॥
1.106.m: The birth of Savitṛ has been told to you; hear next that of the Moon. / From the ten quarters and from the great-souled Atri,

1.106.s:
viṣṇurevābhavadrājanputra sa mṛgalāñchanaḥ ..
dākṣāyaṇī vasornāma patnī dharmasya viśrutā .. 32 ..
1.106.d:
विष्णुरेवाभवद्राजन्पुत्र स मृगलाञ्छनः ॥
दाक्षायणी वसोर्नाम पत्नी धर्मस्य विश्रुता ॥ 32 ॥
1.106.m: it was Viṣṇu alone who became the son marked with the hare, O king. / The daughter of Dakṣa named Vasu, celebrated as the wife of Dharma,

1.106.s:
janayāmāsa dharmajñaṃ vasumadhye niśākaram ..
śrīsahāyastathā jātaḥ somaścāmṛtamanthanāt .. 33 ..
1.106.d:
जनयामास धर्मज्ञं वसुमध्ये निशाकरम् ॥
श्रीसहायस्तथा जातः सोमश्चामृतमन्थनात् ॥ 33 ॥
1.106.m: bore among the Vasus the night-maker who knows dharma; / and Soma, the companion of Śrī, was also born from the churning of the nectar.

1.106.s:
prākāmyena śaśāṅkasya janma te'bhihitaṃ tridhā..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava bhaumasya sambhavam .. 34 ..
1.106.d:
प्राकाम्येन शशाङ्कस्य जन्म तेऽभिहितं त्रिधा॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव भौमस्य सम्भवम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.106.m: The threefold birth of the Moon has thus been declared to you according to will. / Hereafter I shall relate to you the origin of Mars.

1.106.s:
āsīddaityo hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaparākramaḥ ..
sa vai kanyāmajanayadvikeśī nāma nāmataḥ .. 25 ..
1.106.d:
आसीद्दैत्यो हिरण्याक्षो महाबलपराक्रमः ॥
स वै कन्यामजनयद्विकेशी नाम नामतः ॥ 25 ॥
1.106.m: There was a Daitya, Hiraṇyākṣa, of great strength and valour; / he begot a daughter named Vikeśī by name.

1.106.s:
sā lebhe tasya keśām̐stāṃ vai sthāṇurakāmayat ..
tasyāṃ maithunasaktasya deveśasya pinākinaḥ .. 36..
1.106.d:
सा लेभे तस्य केशाम्̐स्तां वै स्थाणुरकामयत् ॥
तस्यां मैथुनसक्तस्य देवेशस्य पिनाकिनः ॥ 36॥
1.106.m: She obtained his hair, and Sthāṇu desired her. / While the lord of the gods, the bearer of the Pināka, was engaged in intercourse with her,

1.106.s:
vahnisammbhavabhītena kṛto vighno hyathāgninā ..
praviṣṭaṃ maithunāgāraṃ vahniṃ dṛṣṭavatastadā .. 37 ..
1.106.d:
वह्निसम्म्भवभीतेन कृतो विघ्नो ह्यथाग्निना ॥
प्रविष्टं मैथुनागारं वह्निं दृष्टवतस्तदा ॥ 37 ॥
1.106.m: an obstacle was made by Agni, who was frightened by the birth of fire. / Then, having seen Agni enter the bedchamber,

1.106.s:
krodhāyāsodbhavaḥ svedo harasya samapadyata ..
ānanasvedajo bindurdevasyāmitraghātinaḥ .. 38 ..
1.106.d:
क्रोधायासोद्भवः स्वेदो हरस्य समपद्यत ॥
आननस्वेदजो बिन्दुर्देवस्यामित्रघातिनः ॥ 38 ॥
1.106.m: sweat arose on Hara born of anger and exertion. / A drop of sweat born from the face of the god, the slayer of his foes,

1.106.s:
tasyāḥ papāta vadane sā papau tatprayatnataḥ ..
antarvatnyatha tenāsīnna śaśāka ca tejasā..39..
1.106.d:
तस्याः पपात वदने सा पपौ तत्प्रयत्नतः ॥
अन्तर्वत्न्यथ तेनासीन्न शशाक च तेजसा॥39॥
1.106.m: fell into her mouth, and she drank it eagerly. / She then became pregnant by it, and could not bear it because of its brilliance;

1.106.s:
mohitā tasya bālasya garbhaṃ dhārayituṃ tadā..
utsasarjātha taṃ garbhaṃ dīptānalasama dyutim .. 1.106.40 ..
1.106.d:
मोहिता तस्य बालस्य गर्भं धारयितुं तदा॥
उत्ससर्जाथ तं गर्भं दीप्तानलसम द्युतिम् ॥ 1.106.40 ॥
1.106.m: bewildered by the brilliance of that child, to bear the embryo then, / she discharged that embryo which had the lustre of blazing fire.

1.106.s:
taṃ dadhāra mahīpāla dharā devīsvarūpiṇī ..
saṃskāramakaroccāsya svayameva ca kaśyapaḥ .. 41 ..
1.106.d:
तं दधार महीपाल धरा देवीस्वरूपिणी ॥
संस्कारमकरोच्चास्य स्वयमेव च कश्यपः ॥ 41 ॥
1.106.m: The Earth in the form of a goddess bore it, O protector of the earth, / and Kaśyapa himself performed his sacraments.

1.106.s:
aṅgāranikaṭasthatvānnāmnā cāṅgārakaḥ kṛtaḥ ..
uktaṃ te janma bhīmasya budhasyātaḥ paraṃ śṛṇu ..42..
1.106.d:
अङ्गारनिकटस्थत्वान्नाम्ना चाङ्गारकः कृतः ॥
उक्तं ते जन्म भीमस्य बुधस्यातः परं शृणु ॥42॥
1.106.m: Because he stayed near glowing charcoal (aṅgāra), he was given the name Aṅgāraka. / The birth of Mars has been told to you; hereafter hear that of Mercury.

1.106.s:
kaśyapasya dhanurnāma patnī trailokyaviśrutā ..
janayāmāsa tanayaṃ rajonāmeti viśrutam .. 43 ..
1.106.d:
कश्यपस्य धनुर्नाम पत्नी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता ॥
जनयामास तनयं रजोनामेति विश्रुतम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.106.m: The wife of Kaśyapa, celebrated throughout the three worlds by the name Dhanu, / gave birth to a son celebrated by the name Rajas.

1.106.s:
so'kāmayata vai kanyāṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vāruṇīmiti vikhyātāṃ trailokyasyaikasundarīm .. 44 ..
1.106.d:
सोऽकामयत वै कन्यां वरुणस्य महात्मनः ॥
वारुणीमिति विख्यातां त्रैलोक्यस्यैकसुन्दरीम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.106.m: He desired the daughter of the great-souled Varuṇa, / known as Vāruṇī, the sole beauty of the three worlds.

1.106.s:
tatastapaśca tejaśca balaṃ vīryaṃ tathaiva ca ..
śulkārthaṃ sa dadau tasyai tānādāya varāṅganā .. 45 ..
1.106.d:
ततस्तपश्च तेजश्च बलं वीर्यं तथैव च ॥
शुल्कार्थं स ददौ तस्यै तानादाय वराङ्गना ॥ 45 ॥
1.106.m: Then as her bride-price, he gave to her his ascetic power, splendour, strength, and virility; / having taken them, that excellent woman

1.106.s:
apsu līnā tadā jātā patasogreṇa dānavaḥ ..
tāmapsu līnāṃ vijñāya praviveśodakaṃ tadā .. 46 ..
1.106.d:
अप्सु लीना तदा जाता पतसोग्रेण दानवः ॥
तामप्सु लीनां विज्ञाय प्रविवेशोदकं तदा ॥ 46 ॥
1.106.m: vanished into the waters; then the Dānava, [scorched] by fierce remorse, / knowing that she had vanished into the waters, then entered the water.

1.106.s:
tasyāḥ sparśopalambhena dravībhūtaḥ sa dānavaḥ ..
